segments.en: From the Heliconian Muses let us begin to sing, who hold the great and holy mount of Helicon, and dance on soft feet about the deep-blue spring and the altar of the almighty son of Cronos, and, when they have washed their tender bodies in Permessus or in the Horse's Spring or Olmeius, make their fair, lovely dances upon highest Helicon and move with vigorous feet. Thence they arise and go abroad by night, veiled in thick mist, and utter their song with lovely voice, praising Zeus the aegis-holder, and queenly Hera of Argos who walks on golden sandals, and the daughter of Zeus the aegis-holder bright-eyed Athena, and Phoebus Apollo, and Artemis who delights in arrows, and Poseidon the earth holder who shakes the earth, and revered Themis, and quick-glancingThe epithet probably indicates coquettishness.Aphrodite, and Hebe with the crown of gold, and fair Dione, Leto, Iapetus, and Cronos the crafty counsellor, Eos, and great Helius, and bright Selene,
segments.zh: 讓我們從赫利孔的繆斯開始歌唱，她們掌控著偉大而聖潔的赫利孔山，在深藍色的清泉與全能的克洛諾斯之子的祭壇周圍，以柔軟的足踏起舞蹈。她們在珀耳墨索斯或馬泉或俄爾墨俄斯洗淨嬌柔的身軀後，就在最高的赫利孔山上翩翩起舞，以有力的足步移動。從那裡她們升起，夜間行進，裹著濃厚的霧靄，發出優美的歌聲，讚頌持盾牌的宙斯、穿著金色涼鞋的王后赫拉（阿爾戈斯之赫拉），以及持盾牌的宙斯之女、明眸的雅典娜，以及福伊波斯‧阿波羅、喜愛箭矢的阿爾忒彌斯、動搖大地的大地之持者波塞頓、令人敬畏的忒彌斯、眼光敏銳的阿芙羅狄忒、戴著金冠的赫貝、美麗的狄俄涅、勒托、伊阿佩托斯、以及心計深遠的克洛諾斯、厄俄斯、偉大的赫利俄斯、光亮的塞勒涅，

segments.en: Earth, too, and great Oceanus, and dark Night, and the holy race of all the other deathless ones that are for ever. And one day they taught Hesiod glorious song while he was shepherding his lambs under holy Helicon, and this word first the goddesses said to me— the Muses of Olympus, daughters of Zeus who holds the aegis: “Shepherds of the wilderness, wretched things of shame, mere bellies, we know how to speak many false things as though they were true; but we know, when we will, to utter true things.” So said the ready-voiced daughters of great Zeus, and they plucked and gave me a rod, a shoot of sturdy laurel, a marvellous thing, and breathed into me a divine voice to celebrate things that shall be and things that were aforetime; and they bade me sing of the race of the blessed gods that are eternally, but ever to sing of themselves both first and last. segments.zh: 大地也在，偉大的俄刻阿諾斯也在，以及黑暗的夜晚，以及永恆不死者的聖潔族群，他們永存不朽。有一日，當赫西俄德在聖潔的赫利孔山牧羊時，她們教會了他光榮的歌曲。女神們這樣首先對我說——奧林匹斯的繆斯，持盾牌的宙斯之女：「荒野的牧羊人，可恥的可憐蟲，不過是肚皮，我們知道如何說出許多假的事物彷彿它們是真的；但我們知道，只要我們願意，也能說出真實的事物。」偉大的宙斯之女，聲調敏捷的她們，這樣說道。她們拔下給了我一根杖，一根強壯月桂樹的嫩枝，一件奇異之物，並向我吹入一個神聖的聲音來歌唱將要發生的事物和以前發生的事物；她們命令我歌唱永恆的福祉之神的族群，但永遠要首先和最後歌唱她們自己。但為什麼要說橡樹或石頭的這一切呢？來吧，讓我們從繆斯開始，她們以她們的歌曲在奧林匹斯使她們父親宙斯的偉大心靈歡欣，歌唱正在發生、將要發生和曾經發生的事物，用一致的聲音。甘甜的聲音不知疲倦地流出

And they, uttering their immortal voice, celebrate in song first of all the revered race of the gods from the beginning, those whom Earth and wide Heaven begot, and the gods sprung of these, givers of good things. Then next, the goddesses sing of Zeus, the father of gods and men, as they begin and end their strain, how much he is the most excellent among the gods and supreme in power. segments.zh: 自她們的唇間，她們的父親宙斯雷霆之聲的殿堂為女神百合花般的聲音而歡欣，聲音四處散播，雪白的奧林匹斯的群峰為之迴響，不死者的住所也為之迴響。而她們，發出不朽的聲音，首先在歌曲中讚頌從遠古起的受人敬畏的神族，即大地和廣闊的天空所生育的，以及由這些神所出、賜予好物之人的神。隨後，女神們歌唱宙斯，諸神與人的父親，她們如此開始和終結她們的歌聲，讚頌他在諸神中如何最卓越、權力最高。再者，她們吟誦人類的族群和強大的巨人族，並在奧林匹斯欣喜宙斯的心——奧林匹斯的繆斯，持盾牌的宙斯之女。記憶女神涅摩西涅在厄琉忒耳的山丘上統治，與克洛諾斯之子父親相合，在皮埃里亞生下了她們，帶來對苦難的遺忘和對悲傷的解脫。智慧的宙斯九夜與她同寢，進入她遠離不死者的聖潔床榻。待一年過去，季節循環，月份消退，許多日子圓滿了，

segments.en: she bore nine daughters, all of one mind, whose hearts are set upon song, and whose spirit is free from care, a little way from the top-most peak of snowy Olympus. There are their bright dancing places and beautiful homes, and beside them the Graces and Himerus (Desire) live in delight. And they, uttering through their lips a lovely voice, sing the laws of all and the goodly ways of the immortals, uttering their lovely voice. Then went they to Olympus, delighting in their sweet voice, with heavenly song, and the dark earth resounded about them as they chanted and a lovely sound rose up beneath their feet as they went to their father. And he was reigning in heaven, himself holding the lightning and glowing thunderbolt, when he had overcome by might his father Cronos; and he distributed fairly to the immortals their portions and declared their privileges. These things, then, the Muses sang who dwell on Olympus, nine daughters begotten by great Zeus, Cleio and Euterpe, Thaleia, Melpomene and Terpsichore, and Erato and Polyhymnia and Urania and Calliope,“She of the noble voice.” Calliope is queen of Epic poetry.who is the chiefest of them all,
segments.zh: 她生了九個女兒，心意相同，她們的心靈沉浸於歌唱，其精神不知憂慮為何物，住在白雪皚皚的奧林匹斯峰頂稍下之處。那裡是她們明亮的舞蹈之地和美麗的居所，三美神和欲望之神希梅羅斯與她們並居其中，樂不可支。她們從唇間發出優美的聲音，唱頌眾神的律法和不朽者的美德，發出優美的聲音。後來她們往奧林匹斯而去，為自己甜美的聲音歡欣，帶著天界的歌唱，昏暗的大地在她們周圍迴響，她們行進時，優美的聲音在腳下升起，前往她們的父親那裡。他統治著天界，親自執掌閃電和熾熱的雷電，在他以強大的力量推翻其父克洛諾斯之後；他公正地向不朽者分配了他們的份額，宣示了他們的權利。這些事，那居於奧林匹斯的繆斯唱頌了，她們是偉大的宙斯的九個女兒，克利俄、歐忒耳珀、塔利亞、墨爾波墨涅和忒耳普西科瑞，厄拉托、波呂許謨尼亞、烏拉尼亞和卡利俄珀——「聲音高貴者」。卡利俄珀是其中最高貴者，她是史詩詩歌的女王。

segments.en: for she attends on worshipful princes: whomever of heaven-nourished princes the daughters of great Zeus honor and behold at his birth, they pour sweet dew upon his tongue, and from his lips flow gracious words. All the people look towards him while he settles causes with true judgements: and he, speaking surely, would soon make wise end even of a great quarrel; for therefore are there princes wise in heart, because when the people are being misguided in their assembly, they set right the matter again with ease, persuading them with gentle words. And when he passes through a gathering, they greet him as a god with gentle reverence, and he is conspicuous amongst the assembled: such is the holy gift of the Muses to men. For it is through the Muses and far-shooting Apollo that there are singers and harpers upon the earth; but princes are of Zeus, and happy is he whom the Muses love: sweet flows speech from his mouth. segments.zh: 因為她侍奉受敬拜的王侯：無論天所養育的王侯中有誰蒙偉大宙斯的女兒們尊敬和眷顧，在他誕生之時，她們就在他舌頭上澆灌甘露，優雅的言辭從他的嘴唇流出。全體人民都注視著他，當他以公正的判決解決爭訟時：他說話確定，很快就能使偉大的紛爭得到智慧的解決；這便是為何有心智聰慧的王侯，因為當人民在集會中被誤導時，他們能用溫和的言辭輕易地改正錯誤，勸服他們。當他經過一個集會時，人們以温柔的恭敬向他問候，如同敬禮一位神，他在聚集的眾人中變得卓著：這就是繆斯贈予人類的神聖禮物。因為正是透過繆斯和遠射的阿波羅，地上才有歌手和琴手；而王侯則來自宙斯，蒙繆斯眷愛的人是幸福的：甘美的言辭從他口中流出。因為雖然一個人在其新近煩亂的靈魂中飽受悲傷和痛苦，生活於恐懼中，因其心靈感到困擾，然而當一位歌手——

And with her went Eros, and comely Desire followed her at her birth at the first and as she went into the assembly of the gods. This honor she has from the beginning, and this is the portion allotted to her amongst men and undying gods,— the whisperings of maidens and smiles and deceits with sweet delight and love and graciousness. But these sons whom he begot himself great Heaven used to call Titans (Strainers) in reproach, for he said that they strained and did presumptuously a fearful deed, and that vengeance for it would come afterwards. And Night bore hateful Doom and black Fate and Death, and she bore Sleep and the tribe of Dreams. And again the goddess murky Night, though she lay with none,
segments.zh: 又因她源於肢體而被稱為歡肉女神。厄洛斯伴隨她而行，美麗的慾望在她出生時、在她初入眾神集會之際跟隨著她。她自太古便享有此榮譽，這是分配給她在人類與不朽之神中的位分——少女的耳語、微笑、欺詐、甜蜜的歡愉、愛慾與溫柔。但這些由他自身生育的兒子們——偉大的天神曾稱他們為泰坦作為辱罵，說他們施行暴力與做出了駭人的大膽之舉，而報應將在後來降臨。夜生出了可恨的命運與黑暗的定數和死亡，她還生出了睡眠與夢幻的族群。又仙女幽暗的夜，雖未與任何人同寢，

Also she bore the Destinies and ruthless avenging Fates, Clotho and Lachesis and Atropos,Clotho (the Spinner) is she who spins the thread of man's life; Lachesis (the Disposer of Lots) assigns to each man his destiny; Atropos (She who cannot be turned) is the “Fury with the abhorre\d shears.”who give men at their birth both evil and good to have, and they pursue the transgressions of men and of gods: and these goddesses never cease from their dread anger until they punish the sinner with a sore penalty. Also deadly Night bore Nemesis (Indignation) to afflict mortal men, and after her, Deceit and Friendship and hateful Age and hard-hearted Strife. But abhorred Strife bore painful Toil and Forgetfulness and Famine and tearful Sorrows, Fightings also, Battles, Murders, Manslaughters, Quarrels, Lying Words, Disputes,
segments.zh: 卻生出了譴責與痛苦的悲哀，以及守護豐饒的黃金蘋果和結實樹木的赫斯珀里得斯——樹木在光榮的俄刻阿諾斯彼方。她也生出了命運與無情的復仇之神——紡者克洛托、分配者拉凱西斯、不可轉向者阿特洛波斯，她們在人的出生時便賦予人以禍福，並追捕人類與神靈的過犯；這些女神的駭人憤怒永不止歇，直至以沉重的懲罰來懲罰犯者。又致命的夜生出了涅墨西斯來折磨凡人，其後生出了欺詐、友誼、可恨的衰老與剛硬之心的紛爭。但被厭棄的紛爭生出了痛苦的勞苦、遺忘、饑荒與淚流的悲哀，又生出了爭鬥、戰役、殺戮、流血衝突、爭執、謊言之詞、糾紛，

And Sea begat Nereus, the eldest of his children, who is true and lies not: and men call him the Old Man because he is trusty and gentle and does not forget the laws of righteousness, but thinks just and kindly thoughts. And yet again he got great Thaumas and proud Phorcys, being mated with Earth, and fair-cheeked Ceto and Eurybia who has a heart of flint within her. segments.zh: 無法無天與毀滅，本性相同，還有誓言，它最令地上的人們苦惱，當誰故意發下虛假的誓言時。海又生出涅瑞烏斯，他的長子，真誠而不欺騙：人們稱他為老人，因為他可信而溫和，不忘公義之法則，思慮公正而善良。他再與蓋亞交媾，生出偉大的陶馬斯與驕傲的福耳基斯，以及美頰的刻托與歐律比亞，她心中有堅硬如火石之物。涅瑞烏斯與豐髮的多里斯之所生，多里斯乃完美之河俄刻阿諾斯之女，其子女眾多，在女神中極其可愛：普羅托、歐克蘭忒、薩俄、安菲特里忒、歐多拉、忒堤斯、加勒涅、格勞刻、庫摩托厄、斯佩俄、托厄與可愛的哈利厄、帕西忒亞、厄拉托、玫瑰臂膀的歐尼刻、優雅的墨利忒、歐利墨涅、阿蓋厄、多托、普羅托、斐魯薩、動力涅、尼薩亞、阿克塔亞與普羅托美德亞，

segments.en: Doris, Panopea, and comely Galatea, and lovely Hippothoe, and rosy-armed Hipponoe, and Cymodoce who with CymatolegeThe “Wave-receiver” and the “Wave-stiller.”and Amphitrite easily calms the waves upon the misty sea and the blasts of raging winds, and Cymo, and Eione, and rich-crowned Alimede, and Glauconome, fond of laughter, and Pontoporea, Leagore, Euagore, and Laomedea, and Polynoe, and Autonoe, and Lysianassa, and Euarne, lovely of shape and without blemish of form, and Psamathe of charming figure and divine Menippe, Neso, Eupompe, Themisto, Pronoe, and Nemertes“The Unerring” or “Truthful”; cp. 1. 235.who has the nature of her deathless father. These fifty daughters sprang from blameless Nereus, skilled in excellent crafts. And Thaumas wedded Electra the daughter of deep-flowing Ocean, and she bore him swift Iris and the long-haired Harpies, Aello (Storm-swift) and Ocypetes (Swift-flier) who on their swift wings keep pace with the blasts of the winds and the birds; for quick as time they dart along.
segments.zh: 多里斯、帕諾珀亞與文雅的加拉忒亞，可愛的希波托厄，玫瑰臂膀的希波諾厄，庫摩多刻與庫瑪托勒格一起在霧靄之海上與狂風怒號之狂飆輕易平息波浪，還有庫摩、厄俄涅、富冠的阿利美德、愛笑的格勞科諾墨、龐托波瑞亞、莉亞戈瑞、歐阿戈瑞、勞美德亞、波呂諾厄、奧托諾厄、呂西阿納薩、歐阿爾涅，形姿可愛而無瑕疵，迷人身姿的普薩瑪忒與神聖的墨尼珀、涅索、歐龐珀、忒彌斯托、普羅諾厄與涅墨爾忒斯，她具有永生父親的本性。這五十位女兒來自無瑕疵的涅瑞烏斯，精於卓越的手藝。陶馬斯娶深流俄刻阿諾斯之女厄勒克特拉為妻，她生下敏捷的厄里斯與長髮的哈耳皮厄，阿埃洛與俄刻俄珀忒斯，她們以迅捷的雙翼與風的狂飆及鳥類並駕齊驅；她們快如時光而飆馳。

segments.en: And again, Ceto bore to Phorcys the fair-cheeked Graiae, sisters grey from their birth: and both deathless gods and men who walk on earth call them Graiae, Pemphredo well-clad, and saffron-robed Enyo, and the Gorgons who dwell beyond glorious Ocean in the frontier land towards Night where are the clear-voiced Hesperides, Sthenno, and Euryale, and Medusa who suffered a woeful fate: she was mortal, but the two were undying and grew not old. With her lay the Dark-haired One i.e.Poseidon.in a soft meadow amid spring flowers. And when Perseus cut off her head, there sprang forth great Chrysaor and the horse Pegasus who is so called because he was born near the springs pegae of Ocean; and that other, because he held a golden blade aor in his hands. Now Pegasus flew away and left the earth, the mother of flocks, and came to the deathless gods: and he dwells in the house of Zeus and brings to wise Zeus the thunder and lightning. But Chrysaor was joined in love to Callirrhoe, the daughter of glorious Ocean, and begot three-headed Geryones. Him mighty Heracles slew
segments.zh: 又，刻托為福耳基斯生下美頰的格瑞亞，姐妹從生就灰白：不死的神明與地上行走的人類都稱她們為格瑞亞，衣履整潔的龐斐多與番紅花衣的厄尼俄，還有那住在光榮的大洋彼岸、靠近黑夜的邊地的戈耳貢，那是清音的赫斯佩里得斯所在，斯忒諾、歐律阿勒與遭受悲慘命運的墨杜薩：她是凡人，但那兩個是不朽的，未曾衰老。黑髮者與她在花簇芬芳的柔軟草地上相偎。當珀爾修斯砍下她的頭顱時，偉大的克律薩俄爾與馬佩加索斯迸然而出，他被這樣稱呼是因為他生於大洋泉水之邊；那個則是因為他手中執持金刃。佩加索斯飛離而去，棄大地、羊群之母而去，來到永生的諸神；他住在宙斯的家中，為慧智的宙斯帶來雷鳴與閃電。克律薩俄爾卻與光榮的俄刻阿諾斯之女卡利羅厄結合，生出三頭的革律翁。他為強力的赫拉克勒斯所誅

segments.en: in sea-girt Erythea by his shambling oxen on that day when he drove the wide-browed oxen to holy Tiryns, and had crossed the ford of Ocean and killed Orthus and Eurytion the herdsman in the dim stead out beyond glorious Ocean. And in a hollow cave she bore another monster, irresistible, in no wise like either to mortal men or to the undying gods, even the goddess fierce Echidna who is half a nymph with glancing eyes and fair cheeks, and half again a huge snake, great and awful, with speckled skin, eating raw flesh beneath the secret parts of the holy earth. And there she has a cave deep down under a hollow rock far from the deathless gods and mortal men. There, then, did the gods appoint her a glorious house to dwell in: and she keeps guard in Arima beneath the earth, grim Echidna, a nymph who dies not nor grows old all her days. Men say that Typhaon the terrible, outrageous and lawless, was joined in love to her, the maid with glancing eyes. So she conceived and brought forth fierce offspring; first she bore Orthus the hound of Geryones, and then again she bore a second, a monster not to be overcome and that may not be described, Cerberus who eats raw flesh, the brazen-voiced hound of Hades, fifty-headed, relentless and strong. And again she bore a third, the evil-minded Hydra of Lerna, whom the goddess, white-armed Hera nourished,
segments.zh: 在大海環繞的厄律忒亞，靠著他那些蹣跚的牛群，正是那一天他把寬額的牛群趕往聖潔的堤林斯，已經渡過了俄刻阿諾斯的淺灘，殺死了俄爾托斯和放牧人歐律提翁，在光輝的俄刻阿諾斯之外的昏暗住處。在一個空洞的山洞裡她生下了另一個怪物，無法抗拒的，絕不像凡人或永恆的諸神，那就是兇暴的女神厄喀德那，她一半是眼睛閃亮、臉頰秀美的仙女，一半又是碩大可怖的蛇，身上有著花紋的皮膚，在聖潔的大地隱祕之處吃生肉。她在那裡有一個山洞，深深地在中空的岩石下方，遠離永恆的諸神和凡人。那時諸神給她指派了一個光輝的住所居住：她在地下的阿里瑪守衛著，嚴厲的厄喀德那，一個不死亡也不衰老的仙女，終其一生。人們說恐怖的、暴虐無法無天的提豐與她相愛，與這位眼睛閃亮的少女。於是她懷孕生下了兇暴的後代；首先她生了格律翁之犬俄爾托斯，然後又生了第二個，一個不可克服、無法描述的怪物，喀耳柏洛斯，他吃生肉，哈得斯那銅聲的獵犬，五十個頭顱，不知疲倦且強大。她再生了第三個，心智邪惡的勒耳那九頭蛇，女神、白臂赫拉撫養著它，

segments.en: Cerceis lovely of form, and soft eyed Pluto, Perseis, Ianeira, Acaste, Xanthe, Petraea the fair, Menestho, and Europa, Metis, and Eurynome, and Telesto saffron-clad, Chryseis and Asia and charming Calypso, Eudora, and Tyche, Amphirho, and Ocyrrhoe, and Styx who is the chiefest of them all. These are the eldest daughters that sprang from Ocean and Tethys; but there are many besides. For there are three thousand neat-ankled daughters of Ocean who are dispersed far and wide, and in every place alike serve the earth and the deep waters, children who are glorious among goddesses. And as many other rivers are there, babbling as they flow, sons of Ocean, whom queenly Tethys bare, but their names it is hard for a mortal man to tell, but people know those by which they severally dwell. And Theia was subject in love to Hyperion and bore great Helius (Sun) and clear Selene (Moon) and Eos (Dawn) who shines upon all that are on earth and upon the deathless Gods who live in the wide heaven.
segments.zh: 美麗的刻爾刻亞，柔眼的普盧托，珀耳塞亞，伊阿涅伊剌，阿卡斯忒，桑忒，美麗的珀特剌亞，墨涅斯托，歐羅巴，墨提斯，歐律諾墨，穿番紅花衣的忒勒斯托，克律塞亞和阿西亞及迷人的卡呂普索，歐多拉，圖刻，安菲羅，俄喀律厄，以及斯堤克斯，她在她們中最為崇高。這些都是從俄刻阿諾斯和忒堤斯生出的最年長的女兒們；然而還有許多別的。因為有三千位踝骨纖細的俄刻阿諾斯之女，她們四處散開，在各地同樣地侍奉著大地與深海，這些是女神中榮耀的兒女。還有許多別的河流，咆哮著流淌，都是俄刻阿諾斯的兒子，皇后忒堤斯所生，但凡人很難講出他們的名字，然而人們知道那些他們各自所住之處的名字。而忒亞被海珀里翁所愛慕，生下偉大的赫利俄斯與澄澈的塞勒涅和照耀著大地上和住在寬闊天界的不死神的厄俄斯。

segments.en: And Eurybia, bright goddess, was joined in love to Crius and bore great Astraeus, and Pallas, and Perses who also was eminent among all men in wisdom. And Eos bore to Astraeus the strong-hearted winds, brightening Zephyrus, and Boreas, headlong in his course, and Notus,—a goddess mating in love with a god. And after these Erigeneia I.e.Eos, the “Early born.” bare the star Eosphorus (Dawn-bringer), and the gleaming stars with which heaven is crowned. And Styx the daughter of Ocean was joined to Pallas and bore Zelus (Emulation) and trim-ankled Nike (Victory) in the house. Also she brought forth Cratos (Strength) and Bia (Force), wonderful children. These have no house apart from Zeus, nor any dwelling nor path except that wherein God leads them, but they dwell always with Zeus the loud-thunderer. For so did Styx the deathless daughter of Ocean plan on that day when the Olympian Lightning god called all the deathless gods to great Olympus, and said that whosoever of the gods would fight with him against the Titans, he would not cast him out from his rights, but each should have the office which he had before amongst the deathless gods.
segments.zh: 光明的女神歐律比亞與克瑞俄斯結成愛侶，生下偉大的阿斯特剌俄斯、帕拉斯及珀耳塞斯，他也因智慧在眾人中卓然出眾。厄俄斯為阿斯特剌俄斯生下強心的諸風，光輝的西風、急馳的北風及南風——一位女神與一位神的愛的結合。此後厄里革涅亞即厄俄斯，「早晨而生者」，生下曙星福斯福魯斯及天界所冠的熠熠群星。俄刻阿諾斯之女斯堤克斯與帕拉斯結合，生下競爭之神澤盧斯與踝骨纖細的勝利女神涅刻在殿中。她也生出克剌托斯與比亞，奇異的兒女。這些沒有遠離宙斯的住所，也沒有住處或路徑，除非是神引領他們的地方，但他們始終與雷聲隆隆的宙斯同住。因為死亡不可能的俄刻阿諾斯之女斯堤克斯就是在那一天通過親父的巧計計畫的，當奧林匹斯的閃電神召喚所有不死的神到偉大的奧林匹斯時，說無論哪一位神會與他聯手對抗泰坦，他都不會把他趕出他的權利，而是每一位都應有他在不死神中之前的職位。

segments.en: And he declared that he who was without office or right under Cronos, should be raised to both office and rights as is just. So deathless Styx came first to Olympus with her children through the wit of her dear father. And Zeus honored her, and gave her very great gifts, for he appointed her to be the great oath of the gods, and her children to live with him always. And as he promised, so he performed fully unto them all. But he himself mightily reigns and rules. Again, Phoebe came to the desired embrace of Coeus. segments.zh: 他宣告說那位在克洛諾斯統治下沒有職位或權利的，應該被提升至職位與權利，正如理應。所以死亡不可能的斯堤克斯首先通過親父的聰慧來到奧林匹斯及她的兒女。宙斯尊敬她，給予她極大的禮物，因為他使她成為眾神偉大的誓言，她的兒女永遠與他同住。正如他所承諾的，他對他們完全履行了一切。但他自己強力地統治與掌權。再者，福埃柏來到科俄斯的渴望的懷抱。然後女神通過神的愛懷孕而生下穿黑衣的勒托，始終溫和，對人類和不死神良善，從始至終溫和，是整個奧林匹斯最溫柔的。她也生下名聲幸運的阿斯特剌亞，珀耳塞斯曾經把她帶到他的大宅中做他摯愛的妻子。她懷孕而生下赫卡忒，克洛諾斯之子宙斯尊敬她超過一切。他給予她華美的禮物，讓她分有大地與不結實的海。她也受到星辰天界的尊敬。

segments.en: and is honored exceedingly by the deathless gods. For to this day, whenever any one of men on earth offers rich sacrifices and prays for favor according to custom, he calls upon Hecate. Great honor comes full easily to him whose prayers the goddess receives favorably, and she bestows wealth upon him; for the power surely is with her. For as many as were born of Earth and Ocean amongst all these she has her due portion. The son of Cronos did her no wrong nor took anything away of all that was her portion among the former Titan gods: but she holds, as the division was at the first from the beginning, privilege both in earth, and in heaven, and in sea.
segments.zh: 她受到不死的諸神極大的尊崇。因為直到今日，凡人中的任何人在地上獻上豐厚的祭品，並按習俗祈求恩寵時，他都會呼喚赫卡忒。她樂意接納誰的祈禱，誰就獲得莫大的榮耀，她也將財富賜予他；因為權力確實掌握在她手中。凡是由大地與俄刻阿諾斯所生的眾神中，她都擁有自己的份額。克洛諾斯之子並未傷害她，也未奪去她在前代泰坦神中的任何份額：反而她保有如同太初分配時一樣的特權，兼掌地、天與海。

segments.zh: 女神出現為他們賜予勝利，樂於將榮耀賜予她所欲之人。在運動競技中她亦良善，因為女神也與他們同在並祐助他們：凡以力量與武力獲勝者輕易地贏得豐厚的獎品，喜悅在心，為其雙親贏得榮耀。她亦樂於護佑騎士，她所欲之人；而對於那些在灰蒙蒙、令人不悅的海上謀生，並祈禱赫卡忒與轟鳴大地之撼動者的人，這位光榮的女神輕易賜予他們豐厚的漁獲，也輕易奪去之，倘若她所願。她在牲畜欄中與赫爾墨斯同在時良善，以增殖牲口。牛群與眾多的山羊群及羊毛羊群，倘若她所願，她從少數增加，或使眾多之物減少。是故，雖然她是母親的獨生女，她在不死的諸神中受到尊崇。

segments.en: And the son of Cronos made her a nurse of the young who after that day saw with their eyes the light of all-seeing Dawn. So from the beginning she is a nurse of the young, and these are her honors. But Rhea was subject in love to Cronos and bore splendid children, Hestia,The goddess of thehearth(the RomanVesta), and so of the house. Cp.Homeric Hymnsv. 22 ff.; XXIX. 1 ff.Demeter, and gold-shod Hera and strong Hades, pitiless in heart, who dwells under the earth, and the loud-crashing Earth-Shaker, and wise Zeus, father of gods and men, by whose thunder the wide earth is shaken. These great Cronos swallowed as each came forth from the womb to his mother's knees with this intent, that no other of the proud sons of Heaven should hold the kingly office amongst the deathless gods. For he learned from Earth and starry Heaven that he was destined to be overcome by his own son, strong though he was, through the contriving of great Zeus.The variant reading “of his father” (sc.Heaven) rests on inferior MS. authority and is probably an alteration due to the difficulty stated by a Scholiast: “How could Zeus, being not yet begotten, plot against his father?” The phrase is, however, part of the prophecy. The whole line may well be spurious, and is rejected by Heyne, Wolf, Gaisford and Guyet.Therefore he kept no blind outlook, but watched and swallowed down his children: and unceasing grief seized Rhea. 但瑞亞為克洛諾斯所愛，生下光榮的子女：赫斯提亞、

子宮來到她的膝上時，一個一個地將他們吞下，目的是
沒有另一個驕傲的天之子能在不朽的眾神中掌握王權。
因為他從大地和星空之天那裡得知，他注定要被他自己的兒子
所推翻，儘管他很強大，通過偉大宙斯的計謀。
因此他沒有盲目的警惕，而是保持警覺，吞下他的兒女：
無盡的哀痛襲擊了瑞亞。但當她將要生下宙斯，眾神與人類之父時，

segments.en: then she besought her own dear parents, Earth and starry Heaven, to devise some plan with her that the birth of her dear child might be concealed, and that retribution might overtake great, crafty Cronos for his own father and also for the children whom he had swallowed down. And they readily heard and obeyed their dear daughter, and told her all that was destined to happen touching Cronos the king and his stout-hearted son. So they sent her to Lyctus, to the rich land of Crete, when she was ready to bear great Zeus, the youngest of her children. Him did vast Earth receive from Rhea in wide Crete to nourish and to bring up. To that place came Earth carrying him swiftly through the black night to Lyctus first, and took him in her arms and hid him in a remote cave beneath the secret places of the holy earth on thick-wooded Mount Aegeum; but to the mightily ruling son of Heaven, the earlier king of the gods, she gave a great stone wrapped in swaddling clothes. Then he took it in his hands and thrust it down into his belly: wretch! he knew not in his heart that in place of the stone his son was left behind, unconquered and untroubled,
segments.zh:
她便懇求她親愛的父母，大地與星空之天，與她一同謀劃
使她親愛孩子的誕生能隱瞞起來，報復也能臨到
偉大而狡猾的克洛諾斯，為了他自己的父親和那些
他所吞下的孩子們。他們欣然聽從並順從他們親愛的女兒，
告訴她所有命定要發生的事，關於克洛諾斯王和他勇敢的兒子。
因此他們把她送到克里特的富饒之地呂克圖斯，當她
準備生下偉大宙斯，她最小的孩子之時。廣大的大地
在遼闊的克里特從瑞亞那裡接過他，將他養育與培養。
大地來到那個地方，穿過黑夜迅速地帶著他去呂克圖斯，
將他抱在懷裡，將他隱藏在一個遠遠的洞穴裡，在聖潔大地
的隱秘之處，在叢林茂密的艾革翁山下；但對那統治強大的
天之子，眾神的早年之王，她給了一塊大石頭包裹著襁褓。
於是他用手接過它，把它吞下腹中：可憐的傢伙！他不知道
他的心中已經留下了取代那塊石頭的兒子，未曾征服，未曾困擾，

segments.en: and that he was soon to overcome him by force and might and drive him from his honors, himself to reign over the deathless gods. After that, the strength and glorious limbs of the prince increased quickly, and as the years rolled on, great Cronos the wily was beguiled by the deep suggestions of Earth, and brought up again his offspring, vanquished by the arts and might of his own son, and he vomited up first the stone which he had swallowed last. And Zeus set it fast in the wide-pathed earth at goodly Pytho under the glens of Parnassus, to be a sign thenceforth and a marvel to mortal men.Pausanias (x.24.6) saw near the tomb of Neoptolemus “a stone of no great size,” which the Delphians anointed every day with oil, and which he says was supposed to be the stone given to Cronos.And he set free from their deadly bonds the brothers of his father, sons of Heaven whom his father in his foolishness had bound. And they remembered to be grateful to him for his kindness, and gave him thunder and the glowing thunderbolt and lightning: for before that, huge Earth had hidden these. In them he trusts and rules over mortals and immortals. Now Iapetus took to wife the neat-ankled maid Clymene, daughter of Ocean, and went up with her into one bed. And she bore him a stout-hearted son, Atlas:
segments.zh:
他很快就要通過力量與威能推翻他，將他從尊位上驅趕出去，
他自己來統治不朽的眾神。此後，王子的力量和光榮的四肢
迅速增長，隨著歲月的流逝，偉大而狡猾的克洛諾斯被
大地的深層建議所欺騙，他重新帶回他的後代，被他自己
兒子的技巧與力量所摧毀，他首先吐出了他最後吞下的石頭。
宙斯把它牢牢地設置在遼闊的大地上，在善良的皮托，
在帕爾那索斯的山谷下，此後成為凡人的一個徵兆與奇蹟。
他還從他們致命的束縛中解救出他父親的兄弟，天之子們
他的父親愚昧地曾經束縛了他們。他們想起對他感恩
他的恩惠，並給了他雷電、熾熱的閃電和閃光：因為之前，
龐大的大地曾隱藏這些。他信任它們，統治著凡人與不朽者。
現在伊阿佩託斯娶了整潔足踝的少女克呂墨涅，大洋之女，
與她進入同一張床。她為他生了一個勇敢的兒子，阿特拉斯：

segments.greek:
τίκτε δʼ ὑπερκύδαντα Μενοίτιον ἠδὲ Προμηθέα
ποικίλον αἰολόμητιν, ἁμαρτίνοόν τʼ Ἐπιμηθέα
ὃς κακὸν ἐξ ἀρχῆς γένετʼ ἀνδράσιν ἀλφηστῇσιν·
πρῶτος γάρ ῥα Διὸς πλαστὴν ὑπέδεκτο γυναῖκα
παρθένον. ὑβριστὴν δὲ Μενοίτιον εὐρύοπα Ζεὺς
εἰς Ἔρεβος κατέπεμψε βαλὼν ψολόεντι κεραυνῷ
εἵνεκʼ ἀτασθαλίης τε καὶ ἠνορέης ὑπερόπλου.
Ἄτλας δʼ οὐρανὸν εὐρὺν ἔχει κρατερῆς ὑπʼ ἀνάγκης
πείρασιν ἐν γαίης, πρόπαρ Εσπερίδων λιγυφώνων,
ἑστηὼς κεφαλῇ τε καὶ ἀκαμάτῃσι χέρεσσιν·
ταύτην γάρ οἱ μοῖραν ἐδάσσατο μητίετα Ζεύς.
δῆσε δʼ ἀλυκτοπέδῃσι Προμηθέα ποικιλόβουλον
δεσμοῖς ἀργαλέοισι μέσον διὰ κίονʼ ἐλάσσας·
καί οἱ ἐπʼ αἰετὸν ὦρσε τανύπτερον· αὐτὰρ ὅ γʼ ἧπαρ
ἤσθιεν ἀθάνατον, τὸ δʼ ἀέξετο ἶσον ἁπάντη
νυκτός ὅσον πρόπαν ἦμαρ ἔδοι τανυσίπτερος ὄρνις.
τὸν μὲν ἄρʼ Ἀλκμήνης καλλισφύρου ἄλκιμος υἱὸς
Ἡρακλέης ἔκτεινε, κακὴν δʼ ἀπὸ νοῦσον ἄλαλκεν
Ἰαπετιονίδῃ καὶ ἐλύσατο δυσφροσυνάων
οὐκ ἀέκητι Ζηνὸς Ὀλυμπίου ὑψιμέδοντος,
segments.en: also she bore very glorious Menoetius and clever Prometheus, full of various wiles, and scatter-brained Epimetheus who from the first was a mischief to men who eat bread; for it was he who first took of Zeus the woman, the maiden whom he had formed. But Menoetius was outrageous, and farseeing Zeus struck him with a lurid thunderbolt and sent him down to Erebus because of his mad presumption and exceeding pride. And Atlas through hard constraint upholds the wide heaven with unwearying head and arms, standing at the borders of the earth before the clear-voiced Hesperides; for this lot wise Zeus assigned to him. And ready-witted Prometheus he bound with inextricable bonds, cruel chains, and drove a shaft through his middle, and set on him a long-winged eagle, which used to eat his immortal liver; but by night the liver grew as much again everyway as the long-winged bird devoured in the whole day. That bird Heracles, the valiant son of shapely-ankled Alcmene, slew; and delivered the son of Iapetus from the cruel plague, and released him from his affliction—not without the will of Olympian Zeus who reigns on high,
segments.zh: 她也生育了極為光榮的墨諾提俄斯和聰慧的普羅米修斯，滿懷各種詭計，以及散亂心思的厄庇米修斯，他從一開始就是吃麵包的人類的禍害；因為他首先從宙斯手中奪取了那女人，即宙斯親手塑造的少女。但墨諾提俄斯為非作歹，遠見的宙斯用閃烈的雷電擊中了他，因他的瘋狂妄想和過度的驕傲將他打入俄瑞布斯。阿特拉斯則因嚴酷的命運而用不知疲倦的頭顱和雙臂撐起廣闊的蒼穹，站立在大地的邊界，在清聲的赫斯珀里得斯前；這乃是智慧的宙斯分配給他的命運。聰慧的普羅米修斯他用不可解的束縛、殘酷的鎖鏈綁住，並刺穿他的腹部，在他身上放置了一隻長翅的鷲鷹，它會啄食他不死的肝臟；但在夜間肝臟會生長回來，生長的量等同於長翅的鳥兒整日啄食的量。那隻鳥兒英勇的赫拉克勒斯——儀態優雅的阿爾克墨涅之子——殺死了它；並將伊阿佩托斯的兒子從殘酷的瘟疫中拯救出來，解救他脫離苦難——這並非違背統治高天的奧林匹斯宙斯的意願，

segments.greek:
ὄφρʼ Ἡρακλῆος Θηβαγενέος κλέος εἴη
πλεῖον ἔτʼ ἢ τὸ πάροιθεν ἐπὶ χθόνα πουλυβότειραν.
ταῦτʼ ἄρα ἁζόμενος τίμα ἀριδείκετον υἱόν·
καί περ χωόμενος παύθη χόλου, ὃν πρὶν ἔχεσκεν,
οὕνεκʼ ἐρίζετο βουλὰς ὑπερμενέι Κρονίωνι.
καὶ γὰρ ὅτʼ ἐκρίνοντο θεοὶ θνητοί τʼ ἄνθρωποι
Μηκώνῃ, τότʼ ἔπειτα μέγαν βοῦν πρόφρονι θυμῷ
δασσάμενος προέθηκε, Διὸς νόον ἐξαπαφίσκων.
τοῖς μὲν γὰρ σάρκας τε καὶ ἔγκατα πίονα δημῷ
ἐν ῥινῷ κατέθηκε καλύψας γαστρὶ βοείῃ,
τῷ δʼ αὖτʼ ὀστέα λευκὰ βοὸς δολίῃ ἐπὶ τέχνῃ
εὐθετίσας κατέθηκε καλύψας ἀργέτι δημῷ.
δὴ τότε μιν προσέειπε πατὴρ ἀνδρῶν τε θεῶν τε·
Ἰαπετιονίδη, πάντων ἀριδείκετʼ ἀνάκτων,
ὦ πέπον, ὡς ἑτεροζήλως διεδάσσαο μοίρας.
ὣς φάτο κερτομέων Ζεὺς ἄφθιτα μήδεα εἰδώς.
τὸν δʼ αὖτε προσέειπε Προμηθεὺς ἀγκυλομήτης
ἦκʼ ἐπιμειδήσας, δολίης δʼ οὐ λήθετο τέχνης·
ζεῦ κύδιστε μέγιστε θεῶν αἰειγενετάων,
τῶν δʼ ἕλεʼ, ὁπποτέρην σε ἐνὶ φρεσὶ θυμὸς ἀνώγει.
segments.en: that the glory of Heracles the Theban-born might be yet greater than it was before over the plenteous earth. This, then, he regarded, and honored his famous son; though he was angry, he ceased from the wrath which he had before because Prometheus matched himself in wit with the almighty son of Cronos. For when the gods and mortal men had a dispute at Mecone, even then Prometheus was forward to cut up a great ox and set portions before them, trying to deceive the mind of Zeus. Before the rest he set flesh and inner parts thick with fat upon the hide, covering them with an ox paunch; but for Zeus he put the white bones dressed up with cunning art and covered with shining fat. Then the father of men and of gods said to him: “Son of Iapetus, most glorious of all lords, good sir, how unfairly you have divided the portions!” So said Zeus whose wisdom is everlasting, rebuking him. But wily Prometheus answered him, smiling softly and not forgetting his cunning trick: “Zeus, most glorious and greatest of the eternal gods, take which ever of these portions your heart within you bids.”
segments.zh: 而是為了底比斯出生的赫拉克勒斯的榮耀在富庶的大地上超越以往。因此他考慮了這事，尊敬他著名的兒子；雖然他曾怒火中燒，但他平息了先前的怒氣，因為普羅米修斯在機智上與全能的克洛諾斯之子相抗衡。因為當眾神和凡人男子在墨科涅發生爭執時，普羅米修斯也曾大膽地宰切一頭巨大的公牛並在眾神面前擺出各個部分，試圖迷惑宙斯的心智。他把肉和厚實的內臟脂肪放在牛皮上擺在最前面，用牛胃覆蓋住它們；但為了宙斯，他把白色的骨頭用狡詐的手法打扮好並用閃閃發光的脂肪覆蓋。那時人類和眾神之父對他說：「伊阿佩托斯之子，最光榮的主宰啊，好先生，你分配這些部分是多麼不公平啊！」永恆智慧的宙斯如此說道，責備他。但狡詐的普羅米修斯帶著淡淡的微笑回答他，不忘他的狡詐詭計：「宙斯啊，永恆眾神中最光榮最偉大的，請任選這些部分中的哪一份你心中所願的。」

segments.greek:
Φῆ ῥα δολοφρονέων· Ζεὺς δʼ ἄφθιτα μήδεα εἰδὼς
γνῶ ῥʼ οὐδʼ ἠγνοίησε δόλον· κακὰ δʼ ὄσσετο θυμῷ
θνητοῖς ἀνθρώποισι, τὰ καὶ τελέεσθαι ἔμελλεν.
χερσὶ δʼ ὅ γʼ ἀμφοτέρῃσιν ἀνείλετο λευκὸν ἄλειφαρ.
χώσατο δὲ φρένας ἀμφί, χόλος δέ μιν ἵκετο θυμόν,
ὡς ἴδεν ὀστέα λευκὰ βοὸς δολίῃ ἐπὶ τέχνῃ.
ἐκ τοῦ δʼ ἀθανάτοισιν ἐπὶ χθονὶ φῦλʼ ἀνθρώπων
καίουσʼ ὀστέα λευκὰ θυηέντων ἐπὶ βωμῶν.
τὸν δὲ μέγʼ ὀχθήσας προσέφη νεφεληγερέτα Ζεύς·
Ἰαπετιονίδη, πάντων πέρι μήδεα εἰδώς,
ὦ πέπον, οὐκ ἄρα πω δολίης ἐπιλήθεο τέχνης.
ὣς φάτο χωόμενος Ζεὺς ἄφθιτα μήδεα εἰδώς·
ἐκ τούτου δὴ ἔπειτα δόλου μεμνημένος αἰεὶ
οὐκ ἐδίδου Μελίῃσι πυρὸς μένος ἀκαμάτοιο
θνητοῖς ἀνθρώποις, οἳ ἐπὶ χθονὶ ναιετάουσιν.
ἀλλά μιν ἐξαπάτησεν ἐὺς πάις Ἰαπετοῖο
κλέψας ἀκαμάτοιο πυρὸς τηλέσκοπον. αὐγὴν
ἐν κοΐλῳ νάρθηκι· δάκεν δέ ἑ νειόθι θυμόν,
Ζῆνʼ ὑψιβρεμέτην, ἐχόλωσε δέ μιν φίλον ἦτορ,
ὡς ἴδʼ ἐν ἀνθρώποισι πυρὸς τηλέσκοπον αὐγήν.
segments.en: So he said, thinking trickery. But Zeus, whose wisdom is everlasting, saw and failed not to perceive the trick, and in his heart he thought mischief against mortal men which also was to be fulfilled. With both hands he took up the white fat and was angry at heart, and wrath came to his spirit when he saw the white ox-bones craftily tricked out: and because of this the tribes of men upon earth burn white bones to the deathless gods upon fragrant altars. But Zeus who drives the clouds was greatly vexed and said to him: “Son of Iapetus, clever above all! So, sir, you have not yet forgotten your cunning arts!” So spake Zeus in anger, whose wisdom is everlasting; and from that time he was always mindful of the trick, and would not give the power of unwearying fire to the MelianA Scholiast explains: “Either because they (men) sprang from the Melian nymphs (cp. 1. 187); or because, when they were born (?), they cast themselves under the ash-trees (μέλιαι), that is, the trees.” The reference may be to the origin of men from ash-trees: cp. Works and Days, 145 and note.race of mortal men who live on the earth. But the noble son of Iapetus outwitted him and stole the far-seen gleam of unwearying fire in a hollow fennel stalk. And Zeus who thunders on high was stung in spirit, and his dear heart was angered when he saw amongst men the far-seen ray of fire.
segments.zh: 他這樣說著，想著欺騙。但永恆智慧的宙斯看見了並未曾不察覺這詭計，他的心中對凡人男子思謀惡事，這些惡事終將被實現。他雙手拿起白色的脂肪，心中怒火中燒，當看見白色的牛骨被狡詐地裝飾起來時，憤怒來到了他的靈魂；因此大地上的人族在芬芳的祭壇上向不死的眾神獻祭白色的骨頭。驅雲的宙斯大為惱怒，對他說：「伊阿佩托斯之子，聰慧無比啊！先生，你還沒忘記你的狡詐手段呢！」永恆智慧的宙斯如此帶著怒火說道；從那時起他就常常牢記這詭計，不願把不知疲倦的火的力量賜予在大地上生活的梅利亞人族的凡人男子。但高貴的伊阿佩托斯之子戰勝了他，在空心的茴香莖中竊取了遠見的不知疲倦之火的光芒。高空雷鳴的宙斯在靈魂中為之刺痛，他親愛的心當看見人類中遠見的火光時為之怒火中燒。

segments.greek:
αὐτίκα δʼ ἀντὶ πυρὸς τεῦξεν κακὸν ἀνθρώποισιν·
γαίης γὰρ σύμπλασσε περικλυτὸς Ἀμφιγυήεις
παρθένῳ αἰδοίῃ ἴκελον Κρονίδεω διὰ βουλάς.
ζῶσε δὲ καὶ κόσμησε θεὰ γλαυκῶπις Ἀθήνη
ἀργυφέη ἐσθῆτι· κατὰ κρῆθεν δὲ καλύπτρην
δαιδαλέην χείρεσσι κατέσχεθε, θαῦμα ἰδέσθαι·
ἀμφὶ δέ οἱ στεφάνους, νεοθηλέος ἄνθεα ποίης,
ἱμερτοὺς περίθηκε καρήατι Παλλὰς Ἀθήνη.
ἀμφὶ δέ οἱ στεφάνην χρυσέην κεφαλῆφιν ἔθηκε,
τὴν αὐτὸς ποίησε περικλυτὸς Ἀμφιγυήεις
ἀσκήσας παλάμῃσι, χαριζόμενος Διὶ πατρί.
τῇ δʼ ἐνὶ δαίδαλα πολλὰ τετεύχατο, θαῦμα ἰδέσθαι,
κνώδαλʼ, ὅσʼ ἤπειρος πολλὰ τρέφει ἠδὲ θάλασσα,
τῶν ὅ γε πόλλʼ ἐνέθηκε,—χάρις δʼ ἀπελάμπετο πολλή,—
θαυμάσια, ζῴοισιν ἐοικότα φωνήεσσιν.
αὐτὰρ ἐπεὶ δὴ τεῦξε καλὸν κακὸν ἀντʼ ἀγαθοῖο.
ἐξάγαγʼ, ἔνθα περ ἄλλοι ἔσαν θεοὶ ἠδʼ ἄνθρωποι,
κόσμῳ ἀγαλλομένην γλαυκώπιδος ὀβριμοπάτρης.
θαῦμα δʼ ἔχʼ ἀθανάτους τε θεοὺς θνητούς τʼ ἀνθρώπους,
ὡς εἶδον δόλον αἰπύν, ἀμήχανον ἀνθρώποισιν.
segments.en: Forthwith he made an evil thing for men as the price of fire; for the very famous Limping God formed of earth the likeness of a shy maiden as the son of Cronos willed. And the goddess bright-eyed Athena girded and clothed her with silvery raiment, and down from her head she spread with her hands an embroidered veil, a wonder to see; and she, Pallas Athena, put about her head lovely garlands, flowers of new-grown herbs. Also she put upon her head a crown of gold which the very famous Limping God made himself and worked with his own hands as a favor to Zeus his father. On it was much curious work, wonderful to see; for of the many creatures which the land and sea rear up, he put most upon it, wonderful things, like living beings with voices: and great beauty shone out from it. But when he had made the beautiful evil to be the price for the blessing, he brought her out, delighting in the finery which the bright-eyed daughter of a mighty father had given her, to the place where the other gods and men were. And wonder took hold of the deathless gods and mortal men when they saw that which was sheer guile, not to be withstood by men.
segments.zh: 於是他為人類鑄造了一樁邪惡之物，作為火的代價；蓋那聞名遐邇的跛足之神按克洛諾斯之子的旨意，用泥土塑造了一位羞怯少女的模樣。明眸的女神雅典娜為她束腰著衣，罩以銀色的衣衫，自其頭頂展開雙手織就繡花的面紗，奇異絕倫；巴拉斯‧雅典娜又在她頭上戴上可愛的花冠，新生草本植物的花朵。她又在其頭上置以金冠，乃是那聞名遐邇的跛足之神親手製作、親手錘鍛，以示崇敬其父宙斯。其上繁飾眾多，奇巧非常；他將陸地與海洋養育的眾多生靈大多刻在其上，奇異之物，彷彿具有聲音的活物：燦爛的光輝從中放射。但他既已鑄成這華美的邪惡，作為福祉的代價，便將其帶出，喜悅於那明眸、大力之父之女所賦予的飾物，來到眾神與人類的所在。當不朽的諸神與凡人的男女見到這位時，驚異執住了他們，因為她純然是詭詐，非人力所能抗拒。

segments.greek:
ἐκ τῆς γὰρ γένος ἐστὶ γυναικῶν θηλυτεράων,
τῆς γὰρ ὀλώιόν ἐστι γένος καὶ φῦλα γυναικῶν,
πῆμα μέγʼ αἳ θνητοῖσι μετʼ ἀνδράσι ναιετάουσιν
οὐλομένης πενίης οὐ σύμφοροι, ἀλλὰ κόροιο.
ὡς δʼ ὁπότʼ ἐν σμήνεσσι κατηρεφέεσσι μέλισσαι
κηφῆνας βόσκωσι, κακῶν ξυνήονας ἔργων—
αἳ μέν τε πρόπαν ἦμαρ ἐς ἠέλιον καταδύντα
ἠμάτιαι σπεύδουσι τιθεῖσί τε κηρία λευκά,
οἳ δʼ ἔντοσθε μένοντες ἐπηρεφέας κατὰ σίμβλους
ἀλλότριον κάματον σφετέρην ἐς γαστέρʼ ἀμῶνται—
ὣς δʼ αὔτως ἄνδρεσσι κακὸν θνητοῖσι γυναῖκας
Ζεὺς ὑψιβρεμέτης θῆκεν, ξυνήονας ἔργων
ἀργαλέων· ἕτερον δὲ πόρεν κακὸν ἀντʼ ἀγαθοῖο·
ὅς κε γάμον φεύγων καὶ μέρμερα ἔργα γυναικῶν
μὴ γῆμαι ἐθέλῃ, ὀλοὸν δʼ ἐπὶ γῆρας ἵκοιτο
χήτεϊ γηροκόμοιο· ὅ γʼ οὐ βιότου ἐπιδευὴς
ζώει, ἀποφθιμένου δὲ διὰ κτῆσιν δατέονται
χηρωσταί· ᾧ δʼ αὖτε γάμου μετὰ μοῖρα γένηται,
κεδνὴν δʼ ἔσχεν ἄκοιτιν ἀρηρυῖαν πραπίδεσσι,
τῷ δέ τʼ ἀπʼ αἰῶνος κακὸν ἐσθλῷ ἀντιφερίζει
segments.en: For from her is the race of women and female kind: of her is the deadly race and tribe of women who live amongst mortal men to their great trouble, no helpmeets in hateful poverty, but only in wealth. And as in thatched hives bees feed the drones whose nature is to do mischief—by day and throughout the day until the sun goes down the bees are busy and lay the white combs, while the drones stay at home in the covered hives and reap the toil of others into their own bellies— even so Zeus who thunders on high made women to be an evil to mortal men, with a nature to do evil. And he gave them a second evil to be the price for the good they had: whoever avoids marriage and the sorrows that women cause, and will not wed, reaches deadly old age without anyone to tend his years, and though he at least has no lack of livelihood while he lives, yet, when he is dead, his kinsfolk divide his possessions amongst them. And as for the man who chooses the lot of marriage and takes a good wife suited to his mind, evil continually contends with good;
segments.zh: 因為女人的種族與女性從她而出：她是致命的種族與女性的部族，她們住在凡人的男子中間，給他們帶來莫大的煩惱，不是在可恨的貧窮中的助手，唯有在財富中才是。就如在茅草搭建的蜂巢中，蜜蜂飼養那本性好作亂的雄蜂——白晝裡，終日直至太陽下山，蜜蜂忙碌著鋪築白色的蜂房，而雄蜂卻待在遮蔽的蜂巢中，將他物的勞作擷取入自己的腹中——同樣地，雷鳴的宙斯使婦女成為凡人男子的邪惡，具有行惡的本性。他還給了他們第二樁邪惡，作為他們所得福祉的代價：誰若躲避婚配與婦女所致的悲傷，不願娶妻，便會達到無人照顧晚年的致命之齡，雖然他在生時無缺衣食，然而他既已過世，親族便瓜分他的家產。至於選擇婚配之路、娶得一位相稱心意的良妻的男子，邪惡與福祉永遠相爭；

segments.greek:
ἐμμενές· ὃς δέ κε τέτμῃ ἀταρτηροῖο γενέθλης,
ζώει ἐνὶ στήθεσσιν ἔχων ἀλίαστον ἀνίην
θυμῷ καὶ κραδίῃ, καὶ ἀνήκεστον κακόν ἐστιν.
ὣς οὐκ ἔστι Διὸς κλέψαι νόον οὐδὲ παρελθεῖν.
οὐδὲ γὰρ Ἰαπετιονίδης ἀκάκητα Προμηθεὺς
τοῖό γʼ ὑπεξήλυξε βαρὺν χόλον, ἀλλʼ ὑπʼ ἀνάγκης
καὶ πολύιδριν ἐόντα μέγας κατὰ δεσμὸς ἐρύκει.
Βριάρεῳ δʼ ὡς πρῶτα πατὴρ ὠδύσσατο θυμῷ
Κόττῳ τʼ ἠδὲ Γύῃ, δῆσεν κρατερῷ ἐνὶ δεσμῷ

segments.en: for whoever happens to have mischievous children, lives always with unceasing grief in his spirit and heart within him; and this evil cannot be healed. So it is not possible to deceive or go beyond the will of Zeus: for not even the son of Iapetus, kindly Prometheus, escaped his heavy anger, but of necessity strong bands confined him, although he knew many a wile. But when first their father was vexed in his heart with Obriareus and Cottus and Gyes, he bound them in cruel bonds, because he was jealous of their exceeding manhood and comeliness and great size: and he made them live beneath the wide-pathed earth, where they were afflicted, being set to dwell under the ground, at the end of the earth, at its great borders, in bitter anguish for a long time and with great grief at heart. But the son of Cronos and the other deathless gods whom rich-haired Rhea bore from union with Cronos, brought them up again to the light at Earth's advising. For she herself recounted all things to the gods fully, how with these they might gain victory and a glorious cause to vaunt themselves.
segments.zh: 因為誰若碰巧有了缺德的兒女，他便永遠在心中與靈魂裡懷著不斷的悲痛而生活；這種邪惡無法療癒。故而欺瞞或超越宙斯的意志是不可能的：即便伊阿佩托斯之子、仁慈的普羅米修斯也未能逃脫他的沉重之怒，反倒因勢所迫被強大的鎖鏈囚禁，雖然他知曉許多詭計。但自從他們的父親心中惱怒於俄布里亞瑞俄斯、科托斯與吉革斯時，他便以殘酷的枷鎖束縛了他們，因為他嫉妒他們超群的男性氣概與美貌和龐大的身軀：他使他們住在廣闊的大地之下，他們在那裡遭受折磨，被迫居住於地下深處、大地的邊陲、其廣大的邊境，在漫長的歲月中與深重的心痛中飽受苦楚。但克洛諾斯之子與那些豐髮瑞亞從與克洛諾斯的結合中所生的其他不朽的神祇，在蓋亞的勸阻下，將他們重新帶向光明。因為她自己將一切事情充分地訴說於眾神，說明藉這些力量他們如何得以贏得勝利與光榮的誇耀之因。

But when he had provided those three with all things fitting, nectar and ambrosia which the gods themselves eat, and when their proud spirit revived within them all after they had fed on nectar and delicious ambrosia, then it was that the father of men and gods spoke amongst them: “Hear me, bright children of Earth and Heaven, that I may say what my heart within me bids. segments.zh: 面對泰坦進行苦澀的衝突；因為記得我們的友善相待，記得你們從殘酷的奴役、從幽冥的黑暗之中回歸光明的痛苦經歷，這都是因著我們的謀畫。」他如此說道。無可非議的克托斯應答他說：「神聖者啊，你說的我們都明白：不，就是我們自己也知道你的智慧與理解力非常超越，你成為了不死者脫離寒冷命運的保衛者。通過你的謀劃，我們已經再次從幽暗之中、從無情的枷鎖中回歸，享受到我們未曾預期的事物，啊主人，克洛諾斯之子。所以現在以堅定的決心與深思熟慮的謀議，我們將在可怕的衝突中援助你的力量，將在艱苦的戰役中與泰坦相戰。」他如此說；眾神，施予美好之物的神，聽聞他的言語後歡聲雷動，他們渴望戰爭的精神比之前更加熾烈，他們全體，男性與女性，那一天都激起了仇恨的戰爭，泰坦諸神，以及一切從克洛諾斯生出者，連同那些恐怖而強力、力量無窮者，

A hundred arms sprang from the shoulders of all alike, and each had fifty heads growing from his shoulders upon stout limbs. These, then, stood against the Titans in grim strife, holding huge rocks in their strong hands. And on the other part the Titans eagerly strengthened their ranks, and both sides at one time showed the work of their hands and their might. The boundless sea rang terribly around, and the earth crashed loudly: wide Heaven was shaken and groaned, and high Olympus reeled from its foundation under the charge of the undying gods, and a heavy quaking reached dim Tartarus and the deep sound of their feet in the fearful onset and of their hard missiles. So, then, they launched their grievous shafts upon one another, and the cry of both armies as they shouted reached to starry heaven; and they met together with a great battle-cry. segments.zh: 乃宙斯從深埋地下的厄瑞波斯之中帶到光明者。百隻臂膊從各自的肩膀上生出，各有五十顆頭顱在他們肩膀上的粗壯四肢上生長。這些，因此挺身對抗泰坦進行殘酷的衝突，在他們強有力的手中高舉著碩大的岩石。另一方面，泰坦積極地整備他們的隊伍，雙方同時展示了他們雙手的工作與力量。無邊的海洋在周圍可怕地鳴響，大地轟然崩落：遼闊的蒼穹搖晃與呻吟，高聳的奧林匹斯在不死之神的衝擊下從其基礎搖晃，沉重的震顫傳達幽暗的塔爾塔羅斯，傳來他們腳步在恐怖的衝擊中與他們堅硬的飛彈的深沉聲音。於是，他們彼此拋擲出沉重的矛，雙軍呐喊的聲音傳到了星空之天；他們以偉大的戰鬥呐喊聲相聚。那時宙斯不再抑制他的力量；他的心立即被憤怒所充滿，他展現出了他全部的力量。從蒼穹與奧林匹斯

segments.en: he came immediately, hurling his lightning: the bolts flew thick and fast from his strong hand together with thunder and lightning, whirling an awesome flame. The life-giving earth crashed around in burning, and the vast wood crackled loud with fire all about. All the land seethed, and Ocean's streams and the unfruitful sea. The hot vapor lapped round the earthborn Titans: flame unspeakable rose to the bright upper air: the flashing glare of the thunderstone and lightning blinded their eyes for all that they were strong. Astounding heat seized Chaos: and to see with eyes and to hear the sound with ears it seemed even as if Earth and wide Heaven above came together; for such a mighty crash would have arisen if Earth were being hurled to ruin, and Heaven from on high were hurling her down; so great a crash was there while the gods were meeting together in strife. Also the winds brought rumbling earthquake and duststorm, thunder and lightning and the lurid thunderbolt, which are the shafts of great Zeus, and carried the clangor and the warcry into the midst of the two hosts. A horrible uproar
segments.zh: 他立刻來臨，投擲他的閃電：箭矢從他強有力的手中密集飛出，伴隨雷鳴和閃光，旋轉著駭人的火焰。賦生的大地在烈火中崩裂四周，浩瀚的林木四面八方噼啪燃燒。全地沸騰，俄刻阿諾斯的水流和不毛之海也沸騰。熱氣籠罩大地之子泰坦們：難以名狀的火焰升騰到明亮的高空；雷石的閃耀和閃電盲了他們的眼，儘管他們力量強大。駭人的熱力攫住了混沌；用眼看和用耳聽，似乎大地和上方遼闊的蒼天要碰到一起；若大地被拋毀，蒼天從上方砸她下來，會發出這樣的巨大轟鳴；而諸神聚戰時就發出這樣的轟鳴。又有風帶來隆隆的地震和塵暴，雷鳴、閃電和暗紅色雷矢──這些是偉大的宙斯的箭矢──把喧囂和戰呼傳入兩軍之中。可怕的騷亂

segments.en: of terrible strife arose: mighty deeds were shown and the battle inclined. But until then, they kept at one another and fought continually in cruel war. And amongst the foremost Cottus and Briareos and Gyes insatiate for war raised fierce fighting: three hundred rocks, one upon another, they launched from their strong hands and overshadowed the Titans with their missiles, and hurled them beneath the wide-pathed earth, and bound them in bitter chains when they had conquered them by their strength for all their great spirit, as far beneath the earth as heaven is above earth; for so far is it from earth to Tartarus. For a brazen anvil falling down from heaven nine nights and days would reach the earth upon the tenth: and again, a brazen anvil falling from earth nine nights and days would reach Tartarus upon the tenth. segments.zh: 慘烈的戰爭升起：大功績展現，戰局傾側。但直到那時，他們彼此衝擊，在殘酷的戰爭中不斷搏鬥。而在最前面科提斯、布里亞瑞俄斯和吉格斯這位好戰不厭的者掀起激烈戰鬥：他們用強有力的手一個接一個投擲三百塊石頭，用飛石遮蔽泰坦，把他們投入寬闊的大地下方，當他們以力量征服了他們時用苦鎖鏈鎖住他們，儘管泰坦精神偉大，幅員遠如天在地之上；因地至塔爾塔羅斯的距離與天在地之上的距離相同。若銅鑄的鐵砧從天墜下九晝夜會於第十日抵達地；反之，銅鑄的鐵砧從地墜下九晝夜會於第十日抵達塔爾塔羅斯。銅圍欄繞其四周，夜如頸飾般展開成三重圍繞其周，而上方生長著大地的根和不毛之海。雲聚者宙斯的旨意下泰坦諸神

segments.en: are hidden under misty gloom, in a dank place where are the ends of the huge earth. And they may not go out; for Poseidon fixed gates of bronze upon it, and a wall runs all round it on every side. There Gyes and Cottus and great-souled Obriareus live, trusty warders of Zeus who holds the aegis. And there, all in their order, are the sources and ends of gloomy earth and misty Tartarus and the unfruitful sea and starry heaven, loathsome and dank, which even the gods abhor. It is a great gulf, and if once a man were within the gates, he would not reach the floor until a whole year had reached its end, but cruel blast upon blast would carry him this way and that. And this marvel is awful even to the deathless gods. There stands the awful home of murky Night wrapped in dark clouds. In front of it the son of Iapetus Sc.Atlas, the Shu of Egyptian mythology: cp. note on line 177.stands immovably upholding the wide heaven upon his head and unwearying hands, where Night and Day draw near and greet one another as they pass the great threshold
segments.zh: 隱埋於霧氣迷茫之中，在暗濕之地，那是浩瀚大地的邊際。他們不得脫出；因波塞頓在其上固定了銅門，牆四面八方繞其周。那裡吉格斯、科提斯和偉大心靈的俄布里亞瑞俄斯住著，持盾牌的宙斯的忠實守衞。而且那裡所有其事物依序排列，是陰沉大地和霧氣籠罩的塔爾塔羅斯以及不毛之海和星輝蒼天的源點和邊際，令人厭惡而暗濕，甚至永生的神祇也厭惡。這是個大鴻溝，若一個人一旦進入門內，到一整年結束都不會抵達地面，但殘酷的一陣陣疾風會把他吹得東搖西晃。這奇跡令甚至不死的神祇感到畏懼。那裡矗立著漆黑之夜的可怖家宅，籠罩在暗雲中。其前方亞皮托斯之子──阿特拉斯──不動地立著，頭與不知疲倦的雙手撐著遼闊的蒼天，夜與晝在那兒相近相迎，當他們經過巨大的門檻時

segments.en: of bronze: and while the one is about to go down into the house, the other comes out at the door. And the house never holds them both within; but always one is without the house passing over the earth, while the other stays at home and waits until the time for her journeying comes; and the one holds all-seeing light for them on earth, but the other holds in her arms Sleep the brother of Death, even evil Night, wrapped in a vaporous cloud. And there the children of dark Night have their dwellings, Sleep and Death, awful gods. The glowing Sun never looks upon them with his beams, neither as he goes up into heaven, nor as he comes down from heaven. And the former of them roams peacefully over the earth and the sea's broad back and is kindly to men; but the other has a heart of iron, and his spirit within him is pitiless as bronze: whomever of men he has once seized he holds fast: and he is hateful even to the deathless gods. There, in front, stand the echoing halls of the god of the lower-world, strong Hades, and of awful Persephone. A fearful hound guards the house in front,
segments.zh: 青銅打造的；而當其中一個準備進入家宅時，另一個從門邊走出。家宅從不同時容納兩者；但始終一個在家宅外遊行於大地之上，而另一個在家中等候，直到她遠行的時刻來臨；其中一個為他們照亮大地上的光芒，洞察一切；另一個則懷抱睡眠——死亡的兄弟，邪惡的夜晚，裹著水霧的雲。黑暗之夜的子女在那裡有其居所，睡眠與死亡，可畏的諸神。熾熱的太陽用他的光芒從不照視他們，既不當他上升進入天空之時，也不當他從天空下降之時。前者安和地遊行於大地與海洋的寬闊背脊，對人類溫善；但後者有著鐵石之心，他內在的靈魂無情如青銅：他一旦捉住哪個凡人便牢牢抓住；甚至對不死的諸神也為所憎恨。那裡，前方立著下界之神、強大的哈得斯和可畏的珀耳塞福涅的回聲大廳。一隻可怕的猛犬守衛著家宅的前方，

segments.en: pitiless, and he has a cruel trick. On those who go in he fawns with his tail and both his ears, but suffers them not to go out back again, but keeps watch and devours whomever he catches going out of the gates of strong Hades and awful Persephone. And there dwells the goddess loathed by the deathless gods, terrible Styx, eldest daughter of backflowingOceanus is here regarded as a continuous stream enclosing the earth and the seas, and so as flowing back upon himself.Ocean. She lives apart from the gods in her glorious house vaulted over with great rocks and propped up to heaven all round with silver pillars. Rarely does the daughter of Thaumas, swift-footed Iris, come to her with a message over the sea's wide back. But when strife and quarrel arise among the deathless gods, and when any one of them who live in the house of Olympus lies, then Zeus sends Iris to bring in a golden jug the great oath of the gods from far away, the famous cold water which trickles down from a high and beetling rock. Far under the wide-pathed earth a branch of Oceanus flows through the dark night out of the holy stream, and a tenth part of his water is allotted to her.
segments.zh: 無情，且有殘忍的詭計。對於進入者，牠用尾巴與兩耳搖晃示好，但不許他們再走出去，反而看守著並吞噬所有被牠捉到從強大的哈得斯和可畏的珀耳塞福涅之門走出的人。那裡住著為不死的諸神所憎恨的女神，可怖的斯堤克斯，逆流俄刻阿諾斯的長女。她與諸神分離住在自己光輝的家宅中，宅頂由巨大的岩石拱起，四週以銀柱撐至天空。塔烏瑪斯之女、疾足的伊里絲甚少越過寬闊的海洋來傳話予她。但當不死的諸神之間起爭執與紛爭，當任何住在奧林匹斯家宅的眾神中說謊，宙斯便遣伊里絲帶著金罐來，盛著遠方的諸神偉大誓言——那著名的冷水，從高聳的突出岩石滴流而下。遠在寬廣通行的大地下，俄刻阿諾斯的一條支流穿越黑暗之夜，流出自聖潔之流，十分之一的水分配給她。

segments.en: With nine silver-swirling streams he winds about the earth and the sea's wide back, and then falls into the mainThe conception of Oceanus is here different: he has nine streams which encircle the earth and the flow out into the “main” which appears to be the waste of waters on which, according to early Greek and Hebrew cosmology, the disk-like earth floated.; but the tenth flows out from a rock, a sore trouble to the gods. For whoever of the deathless gods that hold the peaks of snowy Olympus pours a libation of her water and is forsworn, must lie breathless until a full year is completed, and never come near to taste ambrosia and nectar, but lie spiritless and voiceless on a strewn bed: and a heavy trance overshadows him. But when he has spent a long year in his sickness, another penance more hard follows after the first. For nine years he is cut off from the eternal gods and never joins their councils or their feasts, nine full years. But in the tenth year he comes again to join the assemblies of the deathless gods who live in the house of Olympus. Such an oath, then, did the gods appoint the eternal and primeval water of Styx to be: and it spouts through a rugged place. And there, all in their order, are the sources and ends of the dark earth and misty Tartarus and the unfruitful sea and starry heaven,
segments.zh: 以九道銀色漩渦的水流他環繞著大地與海洋的寬闊背脊，隨後注入本體；但第十道從岩石流出，成為諸神的沉重困擾。不死的諸神中凡住在皚皚奧林匹斯峰頂者澆灑她的水並違背誓言，必須沉默無氣息直到滿一年，永不嘗阿摩羅西亞與仙饌，反而無神無言地躺在鋪陈的床上：沉重的昏迷籠罩他。但在他病中渡過漫長一年後，更嚴酷的懲罰在第一次之後隨之而來。九年間他被斷絕於永恆的諸神外，不參與其議會與宴饗，整整九年。但在第十年他再度前來加入住在奧林匹斯家宅的不死諸神的集會。如此，諸神便指定了永恆而原初的斯堤克斯之水為誓言：她從崎嶇之地噴涌而出。那裡，悉皆按序列，乃是黑暗大地與霧靄塔爾塔羅斯與不毛之海與繁星天空的源頭與終點，

segments.en: loathsome and dank, which even the gods abhor. And there are shining gates and an immovable threshold of bronze having unending roots, and it is grown of itself. I.e.the threshold is of “native” metal, and not artificial.And beyond, away from all the gods, live the Titans, beyond gloomy Chaos. But the glorious allies of loud-crashing Zeus have their dwelling upon Ocean's foundations, even Cottus and Gyes; but Briareos, being goodly, the deep-roaring Earth-Shaker made his son-in-law, giving him Cymopolea his daughter to wed. But when Zeus had driven the Titans from heaven, huge Earth bore her youngest child Typhoeus of the love of Tartarus, by the aid of golden Aphrodite. Strength was with his hands in all that he did and the feet of the strong god were untiring. From his shoulders grew a hundred heads of a snake, a fearful dragon, with dark, flickering tongues, and from under the brows of his eyes in his marvellous heads flashed fire, and fire burned from his heads as he glared. And there were voices in all his dreadful heads
segments.zh: 令人厭惡又陰濕的地方，連眾神都厭惡。那裡有閃耀的門，有動不了的青銅門檻，根深蒂固無窮無盡，它是自然生成的。在那之外，遠離所有眾神，泰坦們住在陰鬱的混沌之外。但雷鳴宙斯光榮的盟友們的住所在俄刻阿諾斯的根基上，即科圖斯和吉革斯；而布里亞柔斯因為品性高尚，深吼的撼地者〔波塞頓〕把他立為女婿，把自己的女兒基摩波萊婭嫁給他。宙斯把泰坦趕出天界之後，碩大的蓋亞與塔爾塔羅斯的愛情生下了她最小的兒子堤豐，在金色阿芙羅狄忒的幫助下。力量伴隨著他的雙手在他做的一切事情上，這位強神的雙足也永不知疲倦。從他的肩膀上長著蛇的一百顆頭，可怕的惡龍，舌頭黑暗閃爍，在他奇異頭顱的眉毛下方，火焰從他的眼睛裡迸發，當他瞪視時，火焰從他的頭上燃燒。在他所有可怕的頭顱裡都有聲音

segments.en: which uttered every kind of sound unspeakable; for at one time they made sounds such that the gods understood, but at another, the noise of a bull bellowing aloud in proud ungovernable fury; and at another, the sound of a lion, relentless of heart; and at another, sounds like whelps, wonderful to hear; and again, at another, he would hiss, so that the high mountains re-echoed. And truly a thing past help would have happened on that day, and he would have come to reign over mortals and immortals, had not the father of men and gods been quick to perceive it. But he thundered hard and mightily: and the earth around resounded terribly and the wide heaven above, and the sea and Ocean's streams and the nether parts of the earth. Great Olympus reeled beneath the divine feet of the king as he arose and earth groaned thereat. And through the two of them heat took hold on the dark-blue sea, through the thunder and lightning, and through the fire from the monster, and the scorching winds and blazing thunderbolt. The whole earth seethed, and sky and sea: and the long waves raged along the beaches round and about at the rush of the deathless gods: and there arose an endless shaking.
segments.zh: 發出各種無法言說的聲音；因為有時候它們發出眾神能理解的聲音，但有時候是公牛的吼聲，在驕傲而不可控制的狂怒中；又有時候是獅子的聲音，心地無情；又有時候，像幼犬的叫聲，驚人地動聽；再有時候，他會發出嘶聲，高山為之回響。確實那一天會發生無法挽救的事情，他會來統治凡人和不朽者，若非人神之父迅速察覺到了。但他雷鳴隆隆地雷擊，周圍的大地恐怖地轟鳴，上方的廣闊蒼穹、大海、俄刻阿諾斯之流和地下世界都是如此。巨大的奧林匹斯在國王起身時的神聖雙足下搖晃，大地因此呻吟。通過他們兩者，熱力控制住了深藍色的海，通過雷鳴和閃電、怪物身上的火焰、灼熱的風和炎燒的雷電。整個大地沸騰，天空和海洋沸騰：長浪沿著四周海灘衝擊，因著不朽眾神的奔騰：無盡的震動隨之而生。

segments.en: Hades trembled where he rules over the dead below, and the Titans under Tartarus who live with Cronos, because of the unending clamor and the fearful strife. So when Zeus had raised up his might and seized his arms, thunder and lightning and lurid thunderbolt, he leaped from Olympus and struck him, and burned all the marvellous heads of the monster about him. But when Zeus had conquered him and lashed him with strokes, Typhoeus was hurled down, a maimed wreck, so that the huge earth groaned. And flame shot forth from the thunderstricken lord in the dim rugged glens of the mount,According to Homer Typhoeus was overwhelmed by Zeus amongst the Arimi in Cilicia. Pindar represents him as buried under Aetna, and Tzetzes read Aetna in this passage.when he was smitten. A great part of huge earth was scorched by the terrible vapor and melted as tin melts when heated by men's art in channelledThe epithet (which means literallywell-bored) seems to refer to the spout of the crucible.crucibles; or as iron, which is hardest of all things, is shortened by glowing fire in mountain glens and melts in the divine earth through the strength of Hephaestus.The fire god. There is no reference to volcanic action: iron was smelted on Mount Ida; cp.Epigrams of Homer,ix. 2-4.Even so, then, the earth melted in the glow of the blazing fire. And in the bitterness of his anger Zeus cast him into wide Tartarus. And from Typhoeus come boisterous winds which blow damply,
segments.zh: 統治地下死者的哈得斯顫抖，與克洛諾斯一起住在塔爾塔羅斯下的泰坦們也顫抖，因為那無盡的喧鬧和可怕的戰鬥。於是當宙斯提起他的力量並拿起他的武器、雷鳴、閃電和陰鬱的雷電時，他從奧林匹斯躍出，擊中了他，燒盡了怪物周身所有的奇異頭顱。但宙斯征服了他並用打擊鞭打他之後，堤豐被投下去，一具殘破的軀殼，巨大的大地為之呻吟。當他被擊中時，火焰從被雷擊中的那位射出，在高山的昏暗崎嶇的峽谷裡。巨大大地的大部分被可怕的蒸汽燒焦了，熔化得像錫被人的手藝在有槽的坩堝中加熱融化；或如鐵，萬物中最堅硬者，被炎熱的火在山間削短，在神聖的大地中通過赫菲斯托斯的力量融化。同樣地，大地在熊熊烈火的光熱中融化了。帶著憤怒的苦澀，宙斯把他投入了廣大的塔爾塔羅斯。從堤豐而來的是喧鬧的風，它們吹著潮濕的氣息，

segments.en: except Notus and Boreas and clear Zephyr. These are a god-sent kind, and a great blessing to men; but the others blow fitfully upon the sea. Some rush upon the misty sea and work great havoc among men with their evil, raging blasts; for varying with the season they blow, scattering ships and destroying sailors. And men who meet these upon the sea have no help against the mischief. Others again over the boundless, flowering earth spoil the fair fields of men who dwell below, filling them with dust and cruel uproar. But when the blessed gods had finished their toil, and settled by force their struggle for honors with the Titans, they pressed far-seeing Olympian Zeus to reign and to rule over them, by Earth's prompting. So he divided their dignities amongst them. Now Zeus, king of the gods, made Metis his wife first, and she was wisest among gods and mortal men. But when she was about to bring forth the goddess bright-eyed Athena, Zeus craftily deceived her
segments.zh: 除了諾圖斯、波瑞亞斯和晴朗的西風。這些是神賜予的種類，對人們是大福祉；但其他風則在海上陣陣吹來。有些猛撲向霧靄的海洋，以邪惡、狂暴的疾風給人們帶來巨大的災害；因為它們隨季節變化而吹動，摧散船隻、毀滅水手。與這些風相遇在海上的人沒有辦法對付這種禍患。還有些風吹過無垠、盛開的大地，毀壞住在下方的人們的良田，用塵埃和殘暴的騷亂填滿它們。但當蒙福的諸神完成了他們的勞作，並以武力平定了他們與泰坦的爭奪榮譽之戰，他們按著大地的勸阻，催促遠見的奧林匹斯宙斯統治和掌管他們。於是他將各種榮譽分配給了他們。現在宙斯，諸神之王，首先娶美狄絲為妻，她是諸神和凡人之中最聰慧的。但當她將要生下明眸的女神雅典娜時，宙斯用巧妙的言辭狡詐地欺騙了她

Γαίης φραδμοσύνῃσι καὶ Οὐρανοῦ ἀστερόεντος.

ἄλλος ἔχοι Διὸς ἀντὶ θεῶν αἰειγενετάων.
ἐκ γὰρ τῆς εἵμαρτο περίφρονα τέκνα γενέσθαι·

ἶσον ἔχουσαν πατρὶ μένος καὶ ἐπίφρονα βουλήν.

ἤμελλεν τέξεσθαι, ὑπέρβιον ἦτορ ἔχοντα·
ἀλλʼ ἄρα μιν Ζεὺς πρόσθεν ἑὴν ἐσκάτθετο νηδύν,
ὡς δή οἱ φράσσαιτο θεὰ ἀγαθόν τε κακόν τε.

Εὐνομίην τε Δίκην τε καὶ Εἰρήνην τεθαλυῖαν,
αἳ ἔργʼ ὠρεύουσι καταθνητοῖσι βροτοῖσι,
Μοίρας θʼ, ᾗ πλείστην τιμὴν πόρε μητίετα Ζεύς,
Κλωθώ τε Λάχεσίν τε καὶ Ἄτροπον, αἵτε διδοῦσι
θνητοῖς ἀνθρώποισιν ἔχειν ἀγαθόν τε κακόν τε.
τρεῖς δέ οἱ Εὐρυνομη Χάριτας τέκε καλλιπαρῄους,
Ὠκεανοῦ κούρη, πολυήρατον εἶδος ἔχουσα,
Ἀγλαΐην τε καὶ Εὐφροσύνην Θαλίην τʼ ἐρατεινήν·
segments.en: with cunning words and put her in his own belly, as Earth and starry Heaven advised. For they advised him so, to the end that no other should hold royal sway over the eternal gods in place of Zeus; for very wise children were destined to be born of her, first the maiden bright-eyed Tritogeneia, equal to her father in strength and in wise understanding; but afterwards she was to bear a son of overbearing spirit king of gods and men. But Zeus put her into his own belly first, that the goddess might devise for him both good and evil. Next he married bright Themis who bore the Horae (Hours), and Eunomia (Order), Dikë (Justice), and blooming Eirene (Peace), who mind the works of mortal men, and the Moerae (Fates) to whom wise Zeus gave the greatest honor, Clotho, and Lachesis, and Atropos who give mortal men evil and good to have. And Eurynome, the daughter of Ocean, beautiful in form, bore him three fair-cheeked Charites (Graces), Aglaea, and Euphrosyne, and lovely Thaleia,
segments.zh: 並以狡計把她放入自己的腹中，如大地和群星的蒼穹所勸告的。他們這樣勸告他，為的是讓沒有其他人代替宙斯在永恆的諸神之上掌握王權；因為注定要從她生下來的孩子都是很聰慧的，首先是處女明眸的特里托革涅婭，在力量和聰慧的理解上等同於她的父親；但之後她將要生下一個傲慢精神的兒子，諸神和人類的王。但宙斯首先把她放入自己的腹中，使女神能為他謀劃善與惡。其次他娶了光輝的忒彌斯為妻，她生了時辰女神（時光）、歐諾彌亞（秩序）、狄刻（正義）和盛開的厄琳涅（和平），她們照看凡人的各種事務，以及命運三女神，聰慧的宙斯賦予了她們最大的榮譽，克洛托、拉刻西斯和阿特洛波斯，她們給予凡人惡與善來擁有。歐律諾彌，俄刻阿諾斯的女兒，容貌美麗，為他生下三位容顏秀麗的美惠三女神（美惠），阿格萊婭、歐佛羅敘涅和可愛的塔利亞，

λυσιμελής· καλὸν δέ θʼ ὑπʼ ὀφρύσι δερκιόωνται.

δεινὴν ἐγρεκύδοιμον ἀγέστρατον Ἀτρυτώνην
πότνιαν, ᾗ κέλαδοί τε ἅδον πόλεμοί τε μάχαι τε,

ἐκ πάντων τέχνῃσι κεκασμένον Οὐρανιώνων.
segments.en: from whose eyes as they glanced flowed love that unnerves the limbs: and beautiful is their glance beneath their brows. Also he came to the bed of all-nourishing Demeter, and she bore white-armed Persephone whom Aidoneus carried off from her mother; but wise Zeus gave her to him. And again, he loved Mnemosyne with the beautiful hair: and of her the nine gold-crowned Muses were born who delight in feasts and the pleasures of song. And Leto was joined in love with Zeus who holds the aegis, and bore Apollo and Artemis delighting in arrows, children lovely above all the sons of Heaven. Lastly, he made Hera his blooming wife: and she was joined in love with the king of gods and men, and brought forth Hebe and Ares and Eileithyia. But Zeus himself gave birth from his own head to bright-eyed Tritogeneia, I.e.Athena, who was born “on the banks of the river Trito” (cp. l. 929l). the awful, the strife-stirring, the host-leader, the unwearying, the queen, who delights in tumults and wars and battles. But Hera without union with Zeus—for she was very angry and quarrelled with her mate—bare famous Hephaestus, who is skilled in crafts more than all the sons of Heaven.
segments.zh: 從她們閃爍的眼眸流出使四肢軟弱的愛；她們眼眉下的眼光是美麗的。他也與全蕩的得墨忒耳同床，她生下白臂的珀耳塞福涅，艾多紐斯從她母親那裡把她奪走了；但聰慧的宙斯把她交給了他。他又愛上了秀髮的摩涅莫敘涅：從她生下九位金冠的繆斯，她們喜愛宴樂和歌唱的快樂。勒托與掌盾牌的宙斯結合，生下阿波羅和喜愛箭矢的阿爾忒彌斯，孩子們在天之子中最可愛。最後，他娶了開花的赫拉為妻：她與諸神和人類之王結合，生下赫貝、阿瑞斯和伊萊都婭。但宙斯本人從自己的頭部生下明眸的特里托革涅婭，即雅典娜，她生於特里托河的河岸（參照第 929l 行），可怕的、引起爭端的、統領軍隊的、不知疲倦的、皇后，她喜歡騷亂、戰爭和戰役。但赫拉沒有與宙斯結合——因為她非常憤怒，與她的配偶不和——生下著名的赫菲斯托斯，他的工藝技巧勝過天之子的所有人。

segments.greek:
Ἐκ δʼ Ἀμφιτρίτης καὶ ἐρικτύπου Ἐννοσιγαίου
Τρίτων εὐρυβίης γένετο μέγας, ὅστε θαλάσσης
πυθμένʼ ἔχων παρὰ μητρὶ φίλῃ καὶ πατρὶ ἄνακτι
ναίει χρύσεα δῶ, δεινὸς θεός. αὐτὰρ Ἄρηι
ῥινοτόρῳ Κυθέρεια Φόβον καὶ Δεῖμον ἔτικτε
δεινούς, οἵτʼ ἀνδρῶν πυκινὰς κλονέουσι φάλαγγας
ἐν πολέμῳ κρυόεντι σὺν Ἄρηι πτολιπόρθῳ,
Ἁρμονίην θʼ, ἣν Κάδμος ὑπέρθυμος θέτʼ ἄκοιτιν.
Ζηνὶ δʼ ἄρʼ Ἀτλαντὶς Μαίη τέκε κύδιμον Ἑρμῆν,
κήρυκʼ ἀθανάτων, ἱερὸν λέχος εἰσαναβᾶσα.
Καδμείη δʼ ἄρα οἱ Σεμέλη τέκε φαίδιμον υἱὸν
μιχθεῖσʼ ἐν φιλότητι, Διώνυσον πολυγηθέα,
ἀθάνατον θνητή· νῦν δʼ ἀμφότεροι θεοί εἰσιν.
Ἀλκμήνη δʼ ἄρʼ ἔτικτε βίην Ἡρακληείην
μιχθεῖσʼ ἐν φιλότητι Διὸς νεφεληγερέταο.
ἀγλαΐην δʼ Ἥφαιστος, ἀγακλυτὸς ἀμφιγυήεις,
ὁπλοτάτην Χαρίτων θαλερὴν ποιήσατʼ ἄκοιτιν.
χρυσοκόμης δὲ Διώνυσος ξανθὴν Ἀριάδνην,
κούρην Μίνωος, θαλερὴν ποιήσατʼ ἄκοιτιν.
τὴν δέ οἱ ἀθάνατον καὶ ἀγήρω θῆκε Κρονίων.
segments.en: And of Amphitrite and the loud-roaring Earth-Shaker was born great, wide-ruling Triton, and he owns the depths of the sea, living with his dear mother and the lord his father in their golden house, an awful god. Also Cytherea bore to Ares the shield-piercer Panic and Fear, terrible gods who drive in disorder the close ranks of men in numbing war, with the help of Ares, sacker of towns; and Harmonia whom high-spirited Cadmus made his wife. And Maia, the daughter of Atlas, bore to Zeus glorious Hermes, the herald of the deathless gods, for she went up into his holy bed. And Semele, daughter of Cadmus was joined with him in love and bore him a splendid son, joyous Dionysus,—a mortal woman an immortal son. And now they both are gods. And Alcmena was joined in love with Zeus who drives the clouds and bore mighty Heracles. And Hephaestus, the famous Lame One, made Aglaea, youngest of the Graces, his buxom wife. And golden-haired Dionysus made brown-haired Ariadne, the daughter of Minos, his buxom wife: and the son of Cronos made her deathless and unageing for him.
segments.zh: 安菲特里忒與聲聲咆哮的大地搖撼者所生之特里同也，偉大而廣域統治之神矣，彼住海洋之深處，與其親愛之母及其父主神居其黃金殿堂，一神之可畏者也。又金色愛神阿芙羅狄忒為戰神阿瑞斯所生，生其盾刺者帕尼克與恐懼，可怕之神也，彼等與城邑掠奪者阿瑞斯之助，在麻木之戰中令人之密集陣列陷於混亂。又生和諧女神哈耳莫尼亞，高傲之卡德摩斯迎為妻。又阿特拉斯之女瑪亞為宙斯所生，生光榮之赫爾墨斯，不死眾神之使者也，蓋彼升入其聖潔之床榻也。又卡德摩斯之女塞墨勒與之相悅而生美好之子，歡樂之戴奧尼索斯——一凡人女子生一不朽之子。今二者皆成神矣。又阿爾克墨涅與雲聚者宙斯相悅而生強大之赫拉克勒斯。又鼎鼎大名之跛足赫菲斯托斯取恩典三女神中最幼者阿格勒亞為豐腴之妻。又金髮戴奧尼索斯取褐髮之米諾斯之女阿里阿德涅為豐腴之妻，克洛諾斯之子使其不死不老以為其妻。

segments.greek:
ἥβην δʼ Ἀλκμήνης καλλισφύρου ἄλκιμος υἱός,
ἲς Ἡρακλῆος, τελέσας στονόεντας ἀέθλους,
παῖδα Διὸς μεγάλοιο καὶ Ἥρης χρυσοπεδίλου,
αἰδοίην θέτʼ ἄκοιτιν ἐν Οὐλύμπῳ νιφόεντι,
ὄλβιος, ὃς μέγα ἔργον ἐν ἀθανάτοισιν ἀνύσσας
ναίει ἀπήμαντος καὶ ἀγήραος ἤματα πάντα.
ἠελίῳ δʼ ἀκάμαντι τέκεν κλυτὸς Ὠκεανίνη
Περσηὶς Κίρκην τε καὶ Αἰήτην βασιλῆα.
Αἰήτης δʼ υἱὸς φαεσιμβρότου Ἠελίοιο
κούρην Ὠκεανοῖο τελήεντος ποταμοῖο
γῆμε θεῶν βουλῇσιν Ἰδυῖαν καλλιπάρῃον.
ἣ δέ οἱ Μήδειαν ἐύσφυρον ἐν φιλότητι
γείναθʼ ὑποδμηθεῖσα διὰ χρυσέην Ἀφροδίτην.
ὑμεῖς μὲν νῦν χαίρετʼ, Ὀλύμπια δώματʼ ἔχοντες,
νῆσοί τʼ ἤπειροί τε καὶ ἁλμυρὸς ἔνδοθι πόντος.
νῦν δὲ θεάων φῦλον ἀείσατε, ἡδυέπειαι
Μοῦσαι Ὀλυμπιάδες, κοῦραι Διὸς αἰγιόχοιο,
ὅσσαι δὴ θνητοῖσι παρʼ ἀνδράσιν εὐνηθεῖσαι
ἀθάναται γείναντο θεοῖς ἐπιείκελα τέκνα.
Δημήτηρ μὲν Πλοῦτον ἐγείνατο, δῖα θεάων,
segments.en: And mighty Heracles, the valiant son of neat-ankled Alcmena, when he had finished his grievous toils, made Hebe the child of great Zeus and goldshod Hera his shy wife in snowy Olympus. Happy he! For he has finished his great work and lives amongst the undying gods, untroubled and unaging all his days. And Perseis, the daughter of Ocean, bore to unwearying Helios Circe and Aeetes the king. And Aeetes, the son of Helios who shows light to men, took to wife fair-cheeked Idyia, daughter of Ocean the perfect stream, by the will of the gods: and she was subject to him in love through golden Aphrodite and bore him neat-ankled Medea. And now farewell, you dwellers on Olympus, and you islands and continents, and you briny sea within. Now sing the company of goddesses, sweet-voiced Muses of Olympus, daughter of Zeus who holds the aegis,—even those deathless ones who lay with mortal men and bore children like gods. Demeter, bright goddess, was joined in sweet love
segments.zh: 強大之赫拉克勒斯，足踝整潔之阿爾克墨涅之勇敢之子，既畢其沉重之勞役，在雪白之奧林匹斯取大宙斯與金履赫拉之女赫貝為羞澀之妻。幸哉其人！蓋彼已畢其大業，住於不死之神間，日日無憂無患不老不衰。又俄刻阿諾斯之女珀耳塞依斯為不厭之赫利俄斯所生，生喀耳刻與埃埃忒斯王。又埃埃忒斯，彼為自示光於人類之赫利俄斯之子，取美頰之伊底婭為妻，彼為俄刻阿諾斯完美之流之女，以神之意志；彼經由金色阿芙羅狄忒之愛而順從於彼，生足踝整潔之美狄亞。願諸安康，奧林匹斯之居民，汝等島嶼與陸地，汝等鹹海之內。今唱頌女神之眾，奧林匹斯之甘言繆斯，持盾牌宙斯之女，彼等不死者與凡人同床而生類神之子者也。明亮女神得墨忒耳與英雄伊阿西翁在克里特富饒之地之三度耕耘之休閒地中相悅而生

segments.greek:
Ἰασίωνʼ ἥρωι μιγεῖσʼ ἐρατῇ φιλότητι
νειῷ ἔνι τριπόλῳ, Κρήτης ἐν πίονι δήμῳ,
ἐσθλόν, ὃς εἶσʼ ἐπὶ γῆν τε καὶ εὐρέα νῶτα θαλάσσης
πάντη· τῷ δὲ τυχόντι καὶ οὗ κʼ ἐς χεῖρας ἵκηται,
τὸν δʼ ἀφνειὸν ἔθηκε, πολὺν δέ οἱ ὤπασεν ὄλβον.
Κάδμῳ δʼ Ἁρμονίη, θυγάτηρ χρυσέης Ἀφροδιτης,
Ἰνὼ καὶ Σεμέλην καὶ Ἀγαυὴν καλλιπάρῃον
Αὐτονόην θʼ, ἣν γῆμεν Ἀρισταῖος βαθυχαίτης,
γείνατο καὶ Πολύδωρον ἐυστεφάνῳ ἐνὶ Θήβῃ.
κούρη δʼ Ὠκεανοῦ, Χρυσάορι καρτεροθύμῳ
μιχθεῖσʼ ἐν φιλότητι πολυχρύσου Ἀφροδίτης,
Καλλιρόη τέκε παῖδα βροτῶν κάρτιστον ἁπάντων,
Γηρυονέα, τὸν κτεῖνε βίη Ἡρακληείη
βοῶν ἕνεκʼ εἰλιπόδων ἀμφιρρύτῳ εἰν Ἐρυθείῃ.
Τιθωνῷ δʼ Ἠὼς τέκε Μέμνονα χαλκοκορυστήν,
Αἰθιόπων βασιλῆα, καὶ Ἠμαθίωνα ἄνακτα.
αὐτὰρ ὑπαὶ Κεφάλῳ φιτύσατο φαίδιμον υἱόν,
ἴφθιμον Φαέθοντα, θεοῖς ἐπιείκελον ἄνδρα.
τόν ῥα νέον τέρεν ἄνθος ἔχοντʼ ἐρικυδέος ἥβης
παῖδʼ ἀταλὰ φρονέοντα φιλομμειδὴς Ἀφροδίτη
segments.en: with the hero Iasion in a thrice-ploughed fallow in the rich land of Crete, and bore Plutus, a kindly god who goes everywhere over land and the sea's wide back, and he makes rich the man who finds him and into whose hands he comes, bestowing great wealth upon him. And Harmonia, the daughter of golden Aphrodite, bore to Cadmus Ino and Semele and fair-cheeked Agave and Autonoe whom long haired Aristaeus wedded, and Polydorus also in rich-crowned Thebes. And the daughter of Ocean, Callirrhoe was joined in the love of rich Aphrodite with stout-hearted Chrysaor and bore a son who was the strongest of all men, Geryones, whom mighty Heracles killed in sea-girt Erythea for the sake of his shambling oxen. And Eos bore to Tithonus brazen-crested Memnon, king of the Ethiopians, and the Lord Emathion. And to Cephalus she bore a splendid son, strong Phaethon, a man like the gods, whom, when he was a young boy in the tender flower of glorious youth with childish thoughts, laughter-loving Aphrodite
segments.zh: 普路托斯，仁善之神也，其行遍陸地與海之寬闊之背，彼使得其者及獲之於手者致富，賜予其人偉大之財富。又金色阿芙羅狄忒之女和諧女神為卡德摩斯所生，生伊諾與塞墨勒與美頰之阿伽微與奧托諾厄，長髮之阿里斯塔俄斯迎之為妻，又生波呂多羅斯也在豐冠之忒拜。又俄刻阿諾斯之女卡利洛厄經由豐饒阿芙羅狄忒之愛與勇敢之克律薩俄爾相悅而生一子，彼為眾人中最強者，革律翁，彼為強大之赫拉克勒斯所殺於海環之厄律忒亞為其搖搖欲墜之牛。又厄俄斯為提托諾斯所生，銅盔之墨姆農，埃塞俄比亞之王，與主神埃馬忒翁。又為刻法羅斯所生一美好之子，強健之法埃同，類神之人也，彼為幼時在光榮青年之稚嫩花朵中具童稚之思想時，好笑之阿芙羅狄忒

segments.greek:
ὦρτʼ ἀναρεψαμένη, καί μιν ζαθέοις ἐνὶ νηοῖς
νηοπόλον νύχιον ποιήσατο, δαίμονα δῖον.
κούρην δʼ Αἰήταο διοτρεφέος βασιλῆος
Αἰσονίδης βουλῇσι θεῶν αἰειγενετάων
ἦγε παρʼ Αἰήτεω, τελέσας στονόεντας ἀέθλους,
τοὺς πολλοὺς ἐπέτελλε μέγας βασιλεὺς ὑπερήνωρ,
ὑβριστὴς Πελίης καὶ ἀτάσθαλος, ὀβριμοεργός.
τοὺς τελέσας Ἰαωλκὸν ἀφίκετο, πολλὰ μογήσας,
ὠκείης ἐπὶ νηὸς ἄγων ἑλικώπιδα κούρην
Αἰσονίδης, καί μιν θαλερὴν ποιήσατʼ ἄκοιτιν.
καί ῥʼ ἥ γε δμηθεῖσʼ ὑπʼ Ἰήσονι, ποιμένι λαῶν,
Μήδειον τέκε παῖδα, τὸν οὔρεσιν ἔτρεφε Χείρων
Φιλυρίδης· μεγάλου δὲ Διὸς νόος ἐξετελεῖτο.
αὐτὰρ Νηρῆος κοῦραι,· ἁλίοιο γέροντος,
ἦ τοι μὲν Φῶκον Ψαμάθη τέκε δῖα θεάων
Αἰακοῦ ἐν φιλότητι διὰ χρυσέην Ἀφροδίτην,
Πηλέι δὲ δμηθεῖσα θεὰ Θέτις ἀργυρόπεζα
γείνατʼ Ἀχιλλῆα ῥηξήνορα θυμολέοντα.
Αἰνείαν δʼ ἄρʼ ἔτικτεν ἐυστέφανος Κυθέρεια
Ἀγχίσῃ ἥρωι μιγεῖσʼ ἐρατῇ φιλότητι
segments.en: seized and caught up and made a keeper of her shrine by night, a divine spirit. And the son of Aeson by the will of the gods led away from Aeetes the daughter of Aeetes the heaven-nurtured king, when he had finished the many grievous labours which the great king, overbearing Pelias, that outrageous and presumptuous doer of violence, put upon him. But when the son of Aeson had finished them, he came to Iolcus after long toil bringing the coy-eyed girl with him on his swift ship, and made her his buxom wife. And she was subject to Iason, shepherd of the people, and bore a son Medeus whom Cheiron the son of Philyra brought up in the mountains. And the will of great Zeus was fulfilled. But of the daughters of Nereus, the Old man of the Sea, Psamathe the fair goddess, was loved by Aeacus through golden Aphrodite and bore Phocus. And the silver-shod goddess Thetis was subject to Peleus and brought forth lion-hearted Achilles, the destroyer of men. And Cytherea with the beautiful crown was joined in sweet love with the hero Anchises and bore Aeneas
segments.zh: 被抓住、被捕獲並立為夜間的聖殿守護者，一位神聖的精靈。而埃松之子憑諸神之意從天育之王埃厄忒斯手中帶走了埃厄忒斯之女，當時他已經完成了許多可怕的勞苦——那是大王、專制的佩利亞所強加於他的，那傲慢而妄自尊大的暴力施行者。埃松之子完成了這些勞苦之後，經過長途跋涉來到了伊俄爾科斯，用他的快速戰船帶著那害羞眼眸的女子同來，並娶她為他豐滿的妻子。她順從於人民牧者伊阿宋，並生下了一個兒子美德歐斯，菲呂剌之子凱龍在山中將他養大。而偉大的宙斯之意得以實現。而在涅柔斯之女中——海中老人的女兒——美麗的女神普薩瑪忒被埃亞庫斯所愛，通過黃金的阿芙羅狄忒，並生下了福庫斯。而銀足的女神忒堤斯順從於佩琉斯，生下了獅心的阿基琉斯，人類的摧毀者。而克律西拉以美麗的王冠與英雄安基塞斯結合在甜蜜的愛中，並生下了埃涅阿斯

segments.greek:
Ἴδης ἐν κορυφῇσι πολυπτύχου ὑληέσσης.
Κίρκη δʼ, Ἠελίου θυγάτηρ Ὑπεριονίδαο,
γείνατʼ Ὀδυσσῆος ταλασίφρονος ἐν φιλότητι
Ἄγριον ἠδὲ Λατῖνον ἀμύμονά τε κρατερόν τε·
Τηλέγονον δʼ ἄρʼ ἔτικτε διὰ χρυσέην Ἀφροδίτην.
οἳ δή τοι μάλα τῆλε μυχῷ νήσων ἱεράων
πᾶσιν Τυρσηνοῖσιν ἀγακλειτοῖσιν ἄνασσον.
Ναυσίθοον δʼ Ὀδυσῆι Καλυψὼ δῖα θεάων
γείνατο Ναυσίνοόν τε μιγεῖσʼ ἐρατῇ φιλότητι.
αὗται μὲν θνητοῖσι παρʼ ἀνδράσιν εὐνηθεῖσαι
ἀθάναται γείναντο θεοῖς ἐπιείκελα τέκνα.
νῦν δὲ γυναικῶν φῦλον ἀείσατε, ἡδυέπειαι
Μοῦσαι Ὀλυμπιάδες, κοῦραι Διὸς αἰγιόχοιο.
segments.en: on the peaks of Ida with its many wooded glens. And Circe the daughter of Helius, Hyperion's son, loved steadfast Odysseus and bore Agrius and Latinus who was faultless and strong: also she brought forth Telegonus by the will of golden Aphrodite. And they ruled over the famous Tyrsenians, very far off in a recess of the holy islands. And the bright goddess Calypso was joined to Odysseus in sweet love, and bore him Nausithous and Nausinous. These are the immortal goddesses who lay with mortal men and bore them children like gods. But now, sweet-voiced Muses of Olympus, daughters of Zeus who holds the aegis, sing of the company of women.
segments.zh: 在林木繁茂的伊達山峰上。而太陽神赫利俄斯、許珀里翁之子的女兒喀耳刻愛上了堅定的俄得修斯，並生下了阿格里俄斯和完美強大的拉提諾斯，她也通過黃金的阿芙羅狄忒的意旨生下了特勒戈諾斯。他們統治了著名的圖爾塞尼人，在神聖島嶼的深處，很遠很遠的地方。而光明的女神卡呂普索與俄得修斯結合在甜蜜的愛中，為他生下了瑙西托俄斯和瑙西諾俄斯。這些是與凡人同臥、為他們生下如神般之子的不朽女神。但現在，甜聲的奧林匹斯繆斯啊，持盾牌的宙斯之女啊，請唱出眾多女子的集合。
